title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist — E-commerce
description:
Media Buyer / Creative Strategist — E-commerce



Remote · Full-time · Long-term



A little about us

We’re looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Media Buyer / Creative Strategist to join our e-commerce business.

We’ve been running our business successfully for more than 2 years, mainly in the health, wellness and beauty space. We use direct-response funnels and sell our products by understanding the customer behind them, their problems, desires, fears and emotions, and translating that into ads and funnels that convert.



We’re a small, ambitious team and like to keep things personal. We have high standards, but we also want people to be themselves, bring their own ideas and genuinely grow together with the business.

And right now, there’s one important person missing from our team: a strong Media Buyer / Creative Strategist.



The role

This role combines media buying and creative strategy.

We already have our own strategies, systems and SOPs in place. We’re looking for someone who can first learn and take ownership of the way we currently work, execute it at a high level, and then use their own experience to bring that extra 10%.

Someone who doesn’t just execute, but over time also thinks with us, spots opportunities and helps us improve our strategies and systems.



Media Buying

You’ll be responsible for the day-to-day media buying of our business.



You will:

- Manage and monitor our Meta campaigns.

- Make decisions around scaling, descaling and relaunching.

- Recognize performance drops and ad fatigue.

- Identify when campaigns need fresh creatives or new briefs.

- Read performance across different timeframes instead of overreacting to one good or bad day.

- Follow and take ownership of our existing systems and SOPs.

- Use your own experience to help us improve the way we work over time.



For us, good media buying isn't just looking at ROAS and making a decision. We want someone who enjoys looking at data and understanding why something is happening and what a campaign actually needs.



Creative Strategy

Once we have a winning product, your job is to help us keep that winner alive and continue scaling it.



You’ll:

- Dive deeper into the customer, their fears, desires, objections and buying motivations.

- Analyze winning ads and understand why they worked.

- Research competitors using Meta Ads Library, Anstrex and other tools.

- Develop new angles, hooks and creative concepts.

- Create clear briefs and work closely with our creative team.

- Use performance data like CTR, CPA and ROAS to determine what we should create next.



We don't care about making ads just because they look nice. We care about creatives that sell an emotion and generate results.



Who we're looking for

Ideally, you already have solid experience in direct-response e-commerce and Meta advertising.

Health, wellness or beauty experience is a big plus, but not a requirement. Strong e-commerce experience combined with the right mindset and willingness to learn is just as important to us.

But experience alone isn't enough. The person behind the experience matters just as much to us.



We’re looking for someone who:

- Has proven Meta media buying experience.

- Understands direct response, consumer psychology and copywriting.

- Is comfortable reading and interpreting data.

- Can explain why an ad or campaign worked.

- Is very detail-oriented and genuinely cares about delivering high-quality work.

- Takes ownership and doesn't need to be told everything.

- Can follow our systems, but also has the experience and confidence to help improve them.

- Is proactive and brings their own ideas to the table.

- Is curious, open to feedback and always looking to improve.

- Has a positive mindset and sees losing tests as opportunities to learn and grow.

- Communicates clearly and is fluent in English.

- Is looking for something long-term and genuinely wants to grow with the team.



Ultimately, we’re not looking for someone who simply completes the tasks we give them.

We want someone who does, thinks and builds with us.



Working hours

This is a full-time role, and availability at specific moments throughout the day is important.



A typical day looks roughly like:

Around 10:00 AM UK time — Morning media buying, followed by creative strategy, research and briefs.

Around 2:00 PM UK time — Second campaign check.

Around 11:00 PM UK time — Final media buying.



This does not mean sitting behind your laptop from 10 AM until 11 PM. There is flexibility between these moments, but we need someone who is comfortable structuring their day around the campaign checks.



Some of the tools we use

Meta Business Manager · Meta Ads Library · Anstrex · Google Sheets · 
 · AI tools



What you can expect from us

- A small, ambitious team with open communication.

- Weekly calls and close collaboration.

- Clear KPIs, expectations and honest feedback.

- Freedom to bring your own ideas and opinions.

- A culture where we see mistakes and losing tests as opportunities to learn and improve.

- A culture focused on both personal and business growth.

- A long-term opportunity to grow your responsibilities and impact together with the business.



We have high standards, but we’re also human. We want to build a team where people can work hard, be themselves, communicate openly and actually enjoy what they're building.



Compensation



We believe good work should always be rewarded fairly.



For this role, we offer $7–$12 USD per hour, depending on your experience, previous results and the value you can bring to the business.



The exact rate will always be discussed together with you. Our goal is to agree on a fair compensation that reflects your experience and feels right for both sides.



For the right person, this is a long-term opportunity to become an important part of our team, take on more responsibility and grow together with the business.



Interested?

Then we'd genuinely like to hear from you!

Please send your application.

And please, don't just send us your CV. Tell us a little about yourself, your experience, what you enjoy about media buying and creative strategy, and why you think you could be a great fit for our team.

If you have previous results, campaigns or creatives you can share, even better. We'd love to see the numbers and hear why you think they worked.

Just be yourself and tell us who you are, what you've done, and what you're looking for.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

WatchDog is a cybersecurity SaaS company building a continuous security assurance platform spanning security posture, compliance/GRC, third-party risk and related areas. title: TikTok Client Success, Onboarding & Project Management
description:
The Role

We are seeking a highly organized and operations-focused TikTok Client Success, Onboarding & Project Management to manage end-to-end client onboarding from signed contract to first live campaign. This role coordinates with Account Executives, pod leads, and Tech Support to track timelines, resolve blockers, ensure smooth client launches, and support the implementation of new TikTok projects, processes, training, and SOPs.



Key Responsibilities

* Owns the end-to-end client onboarding playbook, from signed contract to first live campaign - building on PH SME/taxonomy foundation and keeping it current as the process evolves.

* Runs onboarding hands-on for every new client: joins the kickoff call alongside the AE with a clearly defined lane (AE owns relationship/strategy; this role owns process, timeline, operational next-steps.

* Defines and coordinates the full onboarding work stream per new client, AE handoff, technical setup, creative needs - and owns Tech Support (Shopify integration, inventory sync, category approvals) as part of that setup.

* Acts as the central point of coordination across AE, pod leads, and Tech Support during onboarding - surfacing and triaging blockers before they slip the timeline.

* Owns onboarding CRM/tracking hygiene - one system of record for every client’s stage from signed contract to first campaign launch, visible to TT head and the AEs.

* Holds AEs and pod leads accountable to the onboarding timeline through that tracking system, escalating stalled accounts before they become a client-facing problem.

* Reports onboarding velocity and bottlenecks to TT head on a regular cadence, and recommends process fixes based on patterns across the pipeline.

* Owns any new TikTok project or process from the AE side, scoping what changes for AEs and pod leads, communicating the rollout, and driving adoption on the account side.

* Partners directly with PH SME on implementation. This role owns the underlying training and SOP design, this role owns getting it live and adopted across AEs and accounts.



Work Location / Setup

* Remote

title: AI Image Generation & Photoshop Specialist | Fashion Brand
description:
IMPORTANT: AN INTRO VIDEO IS REQUIRED. APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO WILL NOT BE REVIEWED.



We’re looking for an AI Image Generation & Photoshop Specialist to join our creative team and help us create AI-generated brand imagery that is indistinguishable from real photography.



We’ve built an advanced AI image-generation system using node-based workflows in Magnific. It allows us to create highly realistic imagery while maintaining consistency across models, products, environments, and overall brand aesthetic. The system works, but achieving the level of accuracy we expect still requires significant iteration, attention to detail, and Photoshop expertise.



Every month, we create dedicated AI content batches for both of our brands (Bella Belts and Buckley Belts). These images become part of our central content library and are used across the business, from social media and
 to paid advertising and campaigns.



Because these assets are used at scale and across many different channels, product and visual accuracy are extremely important.



What You’ll Do

You’ll work alongside our current AI Image Generator, who will introduce you to the systems and workflows we’ve developed.

Our process includes:



Creating and working from detailed character and product reference sheets

Developing shot ideas and references

Generating consistent models, environments, styling, and compositions

Running additional AI passes to accurately integrate our products into generated imagery

Using Photoshop and compositing to fix anything AI cannot reproduce accurately

Applying final post-processing to make images feel genuinely photographic

Product accuracy is extremely important to us. We have extensive reference imagery for our products, and small inaccuracies in things like buckles, materials, proportions, or how a belt sits on the body can make an otherwise great image unusable.



Photoshop & Compositing

AI often gets us 90% of the way there. Your job is also to help solve the final 10%.

You should be comfortable with Photoshop, retouching, and compositing, correcting product details, rebuilding problematic areas, removing AI artifacts, and making everything sit naturally within the image.

We also use photographic post-processing such as grain, bloom, chromatic aberration, and other subtle imperfections using Dehancer to further solidify the realism of the final composite.



Improving the System

We don’t just want someone who can operate our current workflow.

AI is moving incredibly quickly, so part of your role will be staying on top of new models, tools, techniques, and node-based workflows that could improve our results or make the process more efficient.

If there’s a better way to achieve product consistency, compositing, character consistency, or photorealism, we want you to find it, test it, and help us implement it.

Longer term, we also want to expand these systems into AI video generation as the technology becomes capable of maintaining the product accuracy we require.



What We’re Looking For



Strong experience with AI image generation

Experience with node-based AI workflows

Strong Photoshop, retouching, and compositing skills

Excellent eye for photorealism, lighting, texture, perspective, and detail

Extremely detail-oriented, particularly around product accuracy

Comfortable with trial and error and troubleshooting difficult generations

Naturally interested in testing new AI models, tools, and techniques

Experience with e-commerce, fashion, product photography, or commercial imagery is a plus





Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who combines AI expertise with strong Photoshop and compositing skills and can consistently produce a high volume of usable, on-brand assets for our wider creative team.

Our standard is simple: the final image shouldn’t look AI-generated.

title: Social Media Content Specialist
description:
Virtual Colleague, under the Shoutout Digital Group, is looking for a Social Media Content Specialist to support one of our established Australian ecommerce clients.

This role is less about how many years you've worked in social media and much more about the quality of work you can actually create. If you have a strong portfolio of Reels, TikToks, carousels and social edits that feel current, engaging and made for the platform, we'd love to see it.



You'll work closely with the client's Creative Lead, who will provide the overall creative direction. Your role is to bring that direction to life through strong editing and day-to-day social execution, while keeping the content calendar, publishing, community and creator coordination running smoothly.



What you'll be doing



- Edit Reels, TikToks and other short-form social content from raw footage and UGC

- Create engaging edits with strong hooks, pacing, typography, captions, transitions and audio

- Repurpose content and create variations for different social platforms

- Keep up with current social trends, editing styles and platform behaviour

- Schedule and publish approved content and keep the content calendar organised

- Make sure posts are formatted, tagged and published correctly

- Respond to comments and DMs in the brand's tone of voice

- Flag customer concerns or sensitive enquiries when needed

- Coordinate with UGC creators, including outreach, follow-ups and tracking deliverables

- Work closely with the Creative Lead and follow established brand direction



What we're looking for



- A strong portfolio of current social-first work. This is the most important part of your application.

- Hands-on experience editing Reels, TikToks and other short-form videos

- A good understanding of hooks, pacing, typography, audio and what keeps people watching

- Experience creating or working with social carousels

- Comfortable with tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Canva or similar

- Experience scheduling and publishing social media content

- Good written (Australian) English and confidence responding to comments and DMs

- Organised, reliable and comfortable managing several moving pieces independently

- Someone who keeps up with social media rather than relying on what worked a few years ago



We're open to candidates from fashion, beauty, lifestyle, ecommerce, interiors, homewares and other visually led brands.



You don't need 5 or 10 years of social media experience. We'd much rather see a smaller body of genuinely strong, current work than years of experience producing traditional or primarily static social content.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote role supporting a client based in Queensland, Australia.



The general working schedule will be:



Monday - Friday

12:00 PM – 8:00 PM AEST (Queensland)

10:00 AM – 6:00 PM Philippine Time



There is some flexibility around the schedule, but you'll need to be available during the client's evening social media window. The brand typically posts around 7:00 PM AEST (5:00 PM PHT), so being online around this time is important for engaging with the community, responding to comments and making sure published content is running smoothly.



Any flexibility around your exact working hours can be discussed during the interview.



Why join us?



At Virtual Colleague, we work with Australian businesses that value long-term relationships, trust and great people.



You'll have clear creative direction and support, while still having plenty of opportunity to use your own skills and social media knowledge. We're looking for someone who enjoys the creative side of social, takes pride in what they publish and wants to grow with a team long-term.



How to Apply



If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd love to see your work.



Please apply through our application form:







Please make sure your application includes a portfolio or links to your best social media work, particularly Reels, TikToks, carousels and short-form video edits. Your portfolio will be one of the main things we use when shortlisting.



The form should only take around 5 minutes to complete.



Please note that we will only review applications submitted through the application form. Applications or follow-up messages sent through OnlineJobs.ph will not be included in the shortlisting process.



If you're shortlisted, we'll invite you to one friendly interview. That's it. No multiple interview rounds or time-consuming unpaid tests. We like to keep the process simple and respectful of everyone's time ;)



We can't wait to learn more about you!

title: Social Media Manager - Fashion Brands
description:
IMPORTANT: AN INTRO VIDEO IS REQUIRED. APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO WILL NOT BE REVIEWED.



We’re looking for a Social Media Manager to take ownership of the organic social presence for Bella Belts and Buckley Belts.

The goal is to make both accounts feel active, intentional, on-brand, and genuinely worth following — not simply a feed where we occasionally publish ads or campaign content.



What You’ll Own:



Social Strategy & Content Planning

You’ll develop and maintain a clear social media strategy for both brands.

This includes d
 on the right content mix and plan ahead accordingly. For example, how much should be UGC, professional brand content, behind-the-scenes, community content, product education, brand storytelling, or more interactive formats etc.

We want you to think about the profile as a whole: what should we post, why are we posting it, and what impression does someone get when they discover the brand through social?

You’ll turn this strategy into content calendars in Notion, working 2–4 weeks ahead. The Head of Brand will then review the proposed schedule, provide feedback, and approve the overall direction.



Posting & Community Management

You’ll handle the day-to-day management of the accounts, including scheduling and publishing posts, Stories, and other content.

For Bella, community is particularly important. You’ll engage with customers to make the account feel like there are real people behind the brand.

Buckley can be more reserved. It doesn’t need the same level of interaction, but it should still feel active and have a strong, recognizable social identity.



Social Content Creation

We already have a large library of professional photos, videos, UGC, product footage, behind-the-scenes content, and other brand assets.

Part of your job is figuring out how to get more out of that library.

For example, you might find several clips from an existing shoot and turn them into a short Reel, create a Story sequence from existing photography, crop and adjust an image for a specific post, add text or graphics, or combine UGC into something that fits the current social strategy.

Because of this, we’re looking for someone with light photo and video editing skills. You don’t need to be a professional editor or graphic designer but you should be comfortable independently turning existing assets into polished, social-first content using tools such as Canva, CapCut, Photoshop, Davinci, or similar.

You’ll also create things like Stories, Highlight content, polls, questions, simple graphics, and other interactive formats that help make the accounts feel branded, playful, and alive.



Campaigns & Cross-Team Alignment

Social should never operate in isolation.

Your content calendar should take into account product launches, Black Friday, Christmas, Valentine’s Day, seasonal moments, promotions, and other important events throughout the year.

You’ll coordinate with our Brand, Creative, and Retention teams so that what we’re communicating on social aligns with what customers are seeing elsewhere.

For example, if Retention is preparing a Black Friday
 campaign, social should complement the campaign rather than feel completely disconnected from it. Messaging, timing, creative direction, and content should make sense together.

Likewise, if you believe a campaign or social idea needs content that doesn’t currently exist, we want you to proactively communicate with the Creative/Brand team and request what you need rather than simply working around it.



Trends & Opportunities

We want someone who naturally keeps an eye on what is happening across Instagram, TikTok, and the wider social landscape.

That could be a new content format, an interesting way another brand uses Stories, a trend we can adapt, a clever community interaction, or simply noticing that part of our profile could be positioned better.

The goal isn’t to blindly follow trends. It’s to recognize what makes sense for Bella or Buckley and translate those opportunities into ideas that still feel like our brands.



What We’re Looking For



Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, and social culture

Strong visual taste and understanding of what makes content feel on-brand

Light photo, graphic, and video editing skills

Ability to turn existing raw assets into engaging social content

Strong organization and the ability to plan several weeks ahead

Understanding of brand voice and community management

Ability to think strategically rather than waiting to be told what to post

Strong communication and ability to coordinate across different teams

Proactive approach to trends, opportunities, and new ideas

Experience with DTC/e-commerce, fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brands is a strong plus





Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who can own social rather than simply manage it, someone who makes sure the right content is going out at the right moments, and ensures that whenever someone visits one of our accounts, the brand feels alive.

You'll join Performia Australia, part of a global Swedish HR consultancy operating in 26 countries. Our mission is to train and support business owners so they know how to identify and build productive, safe and fun teams.



Your end goal is to fill the CEO's calendar with qualified appointments. You'll be proactively prospecting and calling a mix of warm leads, contacts from our database, and cold lists. Your job is to generate the activity that creates the pipeline. You'll qualify them, handle objections, and book them for a meeting with the CEO.



We have a strong lead database and we need you to take ownership of finding and creating opportunities. This means a significant portion of your time will be spent on cold calling and prospecting. The role will be high-volume and requires discipline and resilience.



The role will be challenging and demanding. You'll be expected to make a high volume of calls, face frequent rejection, and maintain a positive, professional attitude. You need to be able to work independently, manage your time effectively, and take full ownership of your results. This is not a role for someone who needs a warm lead handed to them.



In return, you'll be paid a base hourly rate plus a generous bonus for every qualified appointment that is kept. TITLE: Senior AI Creative Editor — Performance Ads (VSL / UGC / Before-After) for a Fast-Growing DTC Ecosystem



— ABOUT US —

We're a fast-growing ecosystem of direct-to-consumer brands selling in the US and French markets. We scale with paid ads, and creative is our #1 growth lever. We're looking for a senior AI creative editor to become our in-house creative machine.



— THE ROLE —

We hand you the concept, script and hook — you execute the best creative possible: AI-generated scenes & B-roll, UGC, avatars, voiceover, editing and assembly. ~15–20 ad creatives per week.



— FORMATS YOU'LL PRODUCE —

Winning ad formats:

• VSLs (video sales letters)

• Testimonials & customer reviews

• Before / After

• UGC-style ads

• Problem → Agitation → Solution (PAS)

• "Us vs Them" / comparison ads

• Founder / brand story

• Listicles & educational explainers ("3 reasons…")

• Mechanism / "how it works" ads

• Advertorial-style videos (long-form storytelling)

• Static advertorial images & image ads

• Short-form / trend-native / meme ads (music-driven)



AI-native formats (where you shine):

• AI UGC & AI avatars / spokespeople (HeyGen)

• AI cinematic scenes & B-roll (Higgsfield, Seedance, Kling)

• AI voiceover VSLs (ElevenLabs) with AI-generated visuals

• AI product-in-scene / lifestyle generation

• Multi-language / multi-market versions via AI dub + perfect lip-sync

• Faceless / AI-driven viral videos

…and any new format that's converting right now.



— WHAT YOU'LL DO —

• Generate AI scenes, B-roll and visuals (Higgsfield, Seedance, Kling — or whatever gets the best result)

• Create AI avatars / UGC and AI voiceover (HeyGen, ElevenLabs)

• Deliver FLAWLESS lip-sync and voice across every format and every market — mission-critical, must be perfect

• Edit and assemble polished, on-brand ads with music, captions and pacing

• Ship 15–20 ad variations per week and iterate on winners



— MUST-HAVE —

• 3+ years editing PERFORMANCE / DTC ADS (not just generic video editing) — mandatory

• Master of AI creative tools (image, video, avatars, voice) — tool-agnostic, but the output must be top-tier

• PERFECT lip-sync & voice work on all formats (HeyGen especially) — this has to be flawless

• Strong editing & assembly (Premiere / After Effects / CapCut / DaVinci)

• Marketing & copy sense — you understand hooks and scroll-stoppers (even though we provide the scripts)

• Fluent English

• A portfolio that proves you can do it ALL (see below)



— NICE TO HAVE —

• Experience creating ads across multiple niches / product categories

• Producing content for multiple markets/languages via AI dubbing & lip-sync



— WHAT WE OFFER —

• Top pay for A-players (based on experience)

• Long-term, stable, full-time role

• Work directly with the founder — real creative ownership

• We pay for ALL your AI tools & subscriptions

• Performance bonuses on winning creatives

• Room to grow into a Lead Creative role as we scale



— HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — we filter) —

1. Start your application with the word "MANGO" so we know you read this.

2. Send a Google Drive link with your portfolio showing ALL the ad formats you've made — VSLs, testimonials, before/after, UGC, AI UGC/avatars, AI B-roll/scenes, statics, and everything else. We want to see the FULL range, and the quality of your lip-sync, voice, editing, AI generation and assembly across every format.

3. In 2–3 lines: which AI tools you use and why, and the best-performing ad you've made (with the result, if you have it).

4. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short PAID test (one real creative) — we judge your work, not your promises.



Serious applicants get a fast reply. If you're a senior who makes the best creatives in the room — apply.

title: Virtual Assistant - Cold Caller (Insurance Company)
description:
We are looking for motivated and professional Medicare Lead Outreach Specialists to join our growing team. In this role, you will contact Medicare prospects, ask basic qualification questions, identify interest in Medicare-related benefits, and transfer qualified consumers to licensed Medicare agents.



This is a non-sales position focused on lead qualification and live transfers.



Responsibilities



Make outbound calls to Medicare prospects from company-provided lead lists.

Verify whether consumers have Medicare Parts A and B or are Medicare eligible.

Ask basic qualification questions regarding Medicaid or state assistance programs.

Identify the consumer's current insurance provider.

Determine interest in reviewing potential Medicare-related benefits such as:

Dental coverage

Vision coverage

OTC (Over-the-Counter) benefits

Food card programs

Utility assistance

Potential premium reduction programs

Warm transfer qualified and interested consumers to licensed Medicare agents.

Provide brief lead notes prior to or during the transfer.

Accurately document call outcomes and transfer results in the CRM system.

Schedule callbacks when consumers are unavailable.





Information to Gather



For interested consumers, agents will collect:



Full Name

Phone Number

State and ZIP Code (when available)

Medicare Parts A and B status

Medicaid status

Current insurance company

Benefits of interest

Preferred callback time (if applicable)





Required Skills & Qualifications+



Previous outbound calling, telemarketing, lead generation, appointment setting, or call center experience preferred.

Excellent communication and active listening skills.

Clear and professional speaking voice.

Ability to build rapport quickly.

Strong attention to detail and accurate note-taking skills.

Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment.

Ability to follow scripts, compliance guidelines, and company procedures.

Compliance Requirements



All agents must strictly follow Medicare, TCPA, DNC, state, and federal regulations.



Agents must never:



Guarantee benefits.

State that a consumer qualifies for specific benefits.

Claim that Medicare owes the consumer money.

Offer Medicare plan recommendations.

Enroll consumers into plans.

Request Medicare numbers, Social Security numbers, banking information, or credit card details.

Contact consumers who request to be placed on a Do Not Call list.

title: Digital Marketing Manager, CRM and Automation
description:

ROLE OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Digital Marketing Manager to lead marketing strategy and manage the systems that turn our website, funnels, and campaigns into a reliable lead-generation engine. This role owns the customer journey from first contact through conversion, with a strong focus on marketing strategy,
 marketing, and paid advertising, supported by CRM management and marketing automation in GoHighLevel (GHL).



This is both a strategic and hands-on role. You will identify conversion opportunities, plan and execute marketing campaigns, and continuously test and optimize performance. The role also includes managing a junior marketer - delegating tasks, reviewing their work, and helping them grow. The ideal candidate is analytical, collaborative, and highly detail-oriented, with the initiative to take projects from strategy through execution.



As part of joining Lypad Academy, you will complete an intensive 40-hour Amazon Influencer Program (AIP) training before transitioning into your regular responsibilities. The training is designed to give you a strong understanding of how the Amazon Influencer business works and the foundational knowledge needed to succeed in your role.



Training runs from September 28 - October 2, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM PHT, including a one-hour lunch break. Full attendance, active participation, and completion of all learning assessments are required.



After successfully completing the training, you will begin a 30-day paid trial period with Lypad Academy, giving you and the team an opportunity to ensure a strong fit for the role. Upon successful completion of the trial period, you will transition to the full contract and benefits package.



Find us here:







WHAT YOU'LL DO

, paid ads, and organic channels

title: Client Success ACCOUNT MANAGER
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

WHO WE ARE



We're a premiere pet care company based in Sydney and we're looking for our amazing growth marketer to own our growth engine and stay with us for the long haul.



THE ROLE



Sit down with the owner, build the marketing plan, and run it.



You will co-ordinate the entire acquisition and retention engine:



Meta Ads: Bring new pet owners in.

: Keep them coming back. 

Social: Make both work better.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Strategy (15%): You’re not waiting for a brief. You build the 90-day rolling marketing calendar. You’ll identify seasonal opportunities (Christmas, School Holidays, New Year routines) and match the right proof points to the right service.



Meta Ads (35%): Run
 & Instagram campaigns across Sydney. Build/test creatives, audiences, and direct landing page creation. You’ll manage a real ad budget (currently [$X]/month) and scale it hard when you prove the returns.

title: Operations Coordinator: Premium Pet Care Company, Sydney AUS
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:



You'll be working for a premium pet care company in Sydney, Australia. One of the city's most trusted providers of dog walking and pet care services. Every day, our field team of walkers and sitters cares for pets across Sydney, and behind them sits an operations team making sure every service happens on time, safely, and to a premium standard.



That's where you come in. This role exists to support our Operations Manager and lighten her load. Handling the day-to-day coordination so she can focus on other projects. It's a crucial hire for us. we're looking for someone who moves fast, thinks ahead, and doesn't wait to be told.

- Acting as a key point of contact for customers: service status, schedules, and pet-related enquiries

- Liaising with walkers and sitters to resolve issues, delays, and coverage gaps quickly and professionally

- Solving coverage problems under pressure — when a tea
mber calls in sick or resigns, YOU work out who covers their dogs and pet sits, fast, before services are missed

- Proactively managing team time-off and liaising with our HR team so we always have coverage where we need it

- Treating every client and every pet as unique, understanding individual requirements and adapting. One size never fits all in pet care.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



- Previous experience in logistics, scheduling, or operations coordination

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy, you close the loop on every enquiry, every update, every time

- The ability to work autonomously. You identify issues before they happen, not after

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Experience with scheduling software and CRM tools

- The ability to move quickly and prioritise under pressure. Calm head, Fast hands

- Commitment to continuous improvement and premium customer service, starting with speedy response times



WHAT WE OFFER:



* Stable, long-term role with a growing company

* Genuine path from part-time to full-time: based on performance, not tenure

* A supportive team that values people who take ownership



HOW TO APPLY:



Start your application with the word PAWS so we know you read this far.



Then include the following three things:



1. Your CV, upload it with your application.



2. A brief intro (short paragraph): tell us how your previous experience and skills translate to this role, and why you'd be the perfect fit. Don't rewrite your CV connect the dots for us. If you've coordinated schedules, managed field teams, handled last-minute chaos, or kept multiple moving parts on track, that's what we want to hear about.



3. Your answer to this scenario (5-8 sentences):



"It's 6:45am. A walker messages to say she's sick and can't work today. She has 8 dogs scheduled between 9am and 3pm. Walk me through exactly what you'd do in the next 30 minutes."



? Extra points: include a short video (1-2 minutes, Loom or phone recording is fine) introducing yourself and telling us why you're the best fit for this role. Not required , but the applicants who do this jump straight to the top of the pile. This role is all about clear, confident communication, so show us yours.



A note on AI: you're welcome to use whatever tools you like but understand that most applicants will paste this into the same engine and send us the same generic answer, and we can spot those instantly. The applications we shortlist will show real coordination experience: the details, trade-offs, and instincts that only come from having actually managed a schedule under pressure. Write it like you've lived it, because we're hiring someone who has.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Advanced Visual Effects / Viral Editing
description:
*REQUIRED EDITING TEST at bottom*

I'm looking for a skilled short-form video editor to edit vertical content for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



This is NOT a basic captioning/cutting position. I'm looking for an editor who can take relatively simple raw footage and turn it into a highly engaging, fast-paced video through strong storytelling and creative visual editing.



You should be very good at:



Visual effects — most important. Creative effects, compositing, masking, tracking, overlays, screen replacements, visual gags, cutouts, background/effect changes, and other edits that visually reinforce what's happening or being said.

Storytelling & cutting. Knowing what to remove, what to emphasize, when to cut, and how to structure footage to maintain retention without needing detailed instructions for every edit.

Framing & movement. Punch-ins, zooms, reframing, tracking subjects, and creating movement from otherwise static footage.

Captions & text animation. Clean, highly readable captions with emphasis on important words and timing that feels native to viral short-form content.

Sound design. Using sound effects, impacts, transitions, music, and other audio elements to make visual moments hit harder.

Pacing. Understanding when a video needs another visual stimulus and keeping the edit moving without making it feel randomly overedited.

REQUIRED EDITING TEST



Every applicant must complete a short test edit.



I will provide the same raw footage to applicants. Your job is to edit it while matching the reference video's style as closely as possible.

I will specifically be judging:



1. Visual effects and creativity — highest priority

2. Storytelling and choice of cuts

3. Pacing/retention

4. Framing, zooms and camera movement

5. Captions and text treatment

6. Sound design

7. Overall similarity to the reference



I'm not looking for someone who simply copies individual effects from the example. I want an editor who understands why and when those effects are being used and can apply that same editing language creatively to completely different footage.



When applying, send me examples of your best short-form edits that use significant visual effects. Please don't send long-form talking-head edits or basic captioned Reels unless they demonstrate the skills above.

title: Anti-Fraud Operations Specialist
description:
Role Overview



The Anti-Fraud Operations Specialist is responsible for protecting our users, platform, and brand from phishing, scams, fake domains, impersonation attempts, and other fraud-related threats. 



The successful candidate will be responsible for monitoring alerts, investigating suspicious activity, documenting findings, submitting abuse and takedown requests, and following established Anti-Fraud SOPs and escalation procedures.



The role requires strong attention to detail, disciplined documentation, sound judgment, and the ability to work carefully with sensitive fraud and security-related cases.



Key Responsibilities

- Monitor and review phishing, scam, impersonation, and other fraud-related alerts and reports.

- Investigate suspicious websites, domains, URLs, links, wallet addresses, and reported fraud cases.

- Submit abuse reports, phishing reports, and takedown requests to relevant platforms, registrars, hosting providers, or other third parties.

- Maintain accurate case trackers, phishing watchlists, investigation records, evidence, and case outcomes.

- Follow established Anti-Fraud SOPs, investigation procedures, and escalation guidelines consistently.

- Act quickly on confirmed or suspected phishing and impersonation cases and escalate high-risk cases when required.

- Coordinate clearly with Support, Security, and other relevant teams to ensure cases are handled appropriately.

- Prepare clear investigation notes, case summaries, status updates, and reports on fraud cases handled.





Candidate Profile

- Highly detail-oriented and able to identify suspicious patterns, inconsistencies, and fraud indicators.

- Reliable and disciplined in maintaining trackers, documentation, evidence, and follow-up records.

- Able to follow SOPs and escalation procedures carefully without skipping required steps.

- Comfortable working with links, websites, forms, reports, spreadsheets, and repetitive investigation tasks.

- Able to investigate information thoroughly and make sound assessments based on available evidence.

- Organized and capable of managing multiple cases while maintaining accuracy and timely follow-ups.

- Able to communicate and coordinate clearly with different internal teams.

- Comfortable handling sensitive fraud and security-related information with discretion and appropriate urgency.



Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience in fraud operations, trust and safety, risk operations, security operations, abuse operations, brand protection, or a related field.

- Experience investigating phishing, scams, impersonation, fake domains, malicious URLs, or other forms of online abuse.

- Familiarity with domain registrations, WHOIS/RDAP information, hosting providers, registrars, social platforms, or common abuse-reporting processes.

- Experience submitting abuse reports or takedown requests to registrars, hosting providers, social media platforms, search engines, or other third parties.

- Familiarity with cryptocurrency or blockchain-related fraud investigations, including reviewing wallet addresses or transaction-related information, is an advantage.

- Experience working with case-management tools, spreadsheets, trackers, ticketing systems, or internal investigation platforms.

- Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts related to phishing, social engineering, malicious domains, and account impersonation is an advantage.



Success in This Role

Success in this role means that fraud-related cases are identified quickly, investigated carefully, documented accurately, escalated appropriately, and followed through to resolution.



The Anti-Fraud Operations Specialist should be someone the organization can rely on to consistently execute established processes, maintain accurate records, recognize suspicious activity, and respond promptly when users or the brand is at risk.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

title: Google Ads Tracking & Integration Developer | Google Ads, GHL, GA4
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established health and fitness business based in Sydney, Australia seeking an experienced Web Developer to troubleshoot and improve our Google Ads conversion tracking and GoHighLevel (GHL) integration.



This is a one-off technical tracking and integration project, with the potential to lead to additional projects and ongoing work for the right person. We already have Google Ads, GHL workflows, and conversion tracking in place, but there are several issues that require developer-level implementation.



THE ROLE

We currently have Google Ads conversion tracking and GHL workflows in place, but some parts of the setup require developer-level fixes.



The main areas we need assistance with are:

- Fixing our GHL to Google Ads offline conversion tracking

- Passing customer
 and phone data for Enhanced Conversions, alongside existing GCLID tracking

- Setting up the required integration using webhooks, Google Ads API, Zapier, Make, or another suitable solution

- Manually implementing and improving Google Ads Enhanced Conversions on our website

- Reviewing our Google Tag / Google Tag Manager setup

- Debugging and consolidating our existing Google Ads conversion actions.  Current set up has multiple overlapping/duplicate conversion actions marked as Primary (including some GA4-based actions). Goal is to have exactly one clean “Lead” conversion (form submission) and one clean “Booking” conversion (completed appointment), with no double-counting.

- Reviewing our two-step lead funnel and setting up separate tracking for lead form submissions and appointment bookings

- Testing and confirming that conversions are being tracked correctly



This is primarily a technical development and tracking role, not Google Ads campaign management.



IDEAL CANDIDATE

- Experience with Google Ads conversion tracking and Enhanced Conversions

- Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Strong knowledge of Google Tag Manager / Google Tag and Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

- Experience with APIs, webhooks, Zapier and/or Make

- Comfortable working with website and backend code

- Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills

- Able to clearly document and explain changes made



Experience specifically with GHL and Google Ads offline conversion tracking is highly preferred.



HOW TO APPLY

To apply for this role, please submit:

1. Your CV

2. A short cover letter

3. Answers to the five questions below



Applications that do not include all three items will not be considered.



Please answer the following:

1. What experience do you have with Google Ads Enhanced Conversions, Google Tag Manager (GTM), and GoHighLevel (GHL)? Please give specific examples.

2. Have you previously implemented Google Ads offline conversions using customer
/phone data through an API, webhook, Zapier, Make, or a similar solution? Please briefly explain the setup.

3. How would you approach passing customer
 and phone data from GHL to Google Ads when GHL's native workflow action does not support these fields?

4. How would you test and verify that Enhanced Conversions and offline conversion tracking are working correctly after implementation?

5. Please provide an example of a similar tracking or integration project you have completed, along with your estimated rate and availability for this project.

“Google Ads Tracking – Detail Matters”



This confirms you have read the full job description carefully.

title: Meta Ads Performance Specialist - LIVE EVENTS
description:
We’re looking for one full-time Meta Ads Performance Specialist to monitor and improve a high volume of Meta advertising campaigns for touring comedians, comedy producers, and live comedy venues.



Most of our campaigns are focused on selling tickets.



You will be responsible for making sure active campaigns are reviewed on schedule, performance issues are identified early, appropriate optimizations are made, and campaigns that need follow-up are not forgotten.



This is a high-volume performance role.



It is not a campaign-building, account management, creative, or general VA role.



What You’ll Be Doing



You’ll monitor active campaigns across multiple Meta ad accounts.



For most campaigns, the review will be straightforward: check the important metrics, confirm performance looks healthy, record the review, and move on.



When something looks wrong, you’ll investigate further and d
 what action is appropriate.



You’ll regularly review:



Spend

Purchases

Cost per purchase

Revenue

ROAS

Cost per ticket-page/search click

Frequency

Budget pacing

Campaign and ad delivery

Purchase tracking



Depending on the situation, you may:



Pause underperforming ads

Reallocate spend within an approved budget

Adjust or broaden audiences

Investigate unusual campaign delivery

Identify possible build or tracking issues

Flag when creative appears to be limiting performance

Schedule follow-up reviews after making changes



If another team member needs to fix a build issue or provide something outside your control, you’ll flag it to the appropriate person and make sure the campaign is checked again afterward.



You’ll also prepare weekly performance reports for active campaigns.



Experience We’re Looking For



You should already be very comfortable using Meta Ads Manager.



We should not need to teach you the basics of Meta advertising.



You should have experience:



Monitoring and optimizing campaigns after launch

Working across multiple Meta ad accounts

Reviewing performance at campaign, ad set, and ad level

Understanding ROAS, CPA, CTR, frequency, spend, and conversion data

Comparing individual ads and identifying wasted spend

Making routine optimization decisions

Investigating campaigns that are not performing as expected

Managing a large number of active campaigns without losing track of follow-ups



Experience managing 10+ Meta ad accounts at the same time is strongly preferred.



Experience with live events, ticket sales, entertainment, or local businesses is helpful, but not required.



Ownership



We’re looking for someone who can take responsibility for this function.



You should not need to be reminded which campaigns need checking or which issues still need follow-up.



When something looks wrong, we expect you to investigate it before asking someone else what to do.



As you learn how we run ticket campaigns, you’ll be trusted to make more routine performance decisions independently.



You should also be comfortable leaving a campaign alone when there is no good reason to change it.



What This Role Does Not Include



You will not be responsible for:



Building campaigns from scratch

Producing creative

Writing ad copy

Managing client relationships

Chasing clients for assets or approvals

Sales

Managing our own company marketing

General administrative work



Your focus is the performance of campaigns after they go live.



What Success Looks Like



You’re doing the job well when:



Every active campaign is reviewed when it should be

Problems are identified early

Healthy campaigns are not changed unnecessarily

Routine optimizations are handled independently

Campaigns requiring follow-up are not forgotten

Build or tracking issues are clearly identified

Campaign notes and review dates stay current

Weekly reporting is accurate

The founder does not need to personally check Ads Manager to make sure campaigns are being looked after

Working Hours & Compensation



This is a full-time role working approximately 40 hours per week on a standard Philippine daytime schedule.



Compensation is US$900–$1,100 per month, depending on experience.



We are hiring an individual team member for a long-term role.



Applications from agencies, outsourcing companies, or applicants planning to subcontract the work will not be considered.



How to Apply



Please follow these instructions exactly.



Use the word ROAS in your subject line

Select 6 AP points

Briefly describe your experience using Meta Ads

What is the largest number of Meta ad accounts you have personally managed at the same time?

Roughly how many live campaigns were you personally responsible for monitoring at once?

Roughly what percentage of your Meta Ads work has been ongoing monitoring/optimization versus campaign building?

Briefly describe any experience you have advertising live events, ticket sales, entertainment, or local businesses



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

Profiles

Submit a 1-2 page PDF audit of the top 3 ranked roofing company profiles on local pack for the query "dakdekker den haag."

title: BOOKKEEPER & FINANCE ADMINISTRATOR (Home Based)
description:
# BOOKKEEPER & FINANCE ADMINISTRATOR – FULL TIME VA



**Location:** Philippines – Home-based (outside Metro Manila preferred)  

**Work Type:** Full-Time VA Role – Independent Service Provider, Not Employment  

**Hours:** 45 hours/week, Monday–Friday  

**Shift:** Brisbane, Australia business hours



## About the Role



We are looking for an experienced **Bookkeeper & Finance Administrator** to take ownership of the day-to-day bookkeeping and finance administration across our growing Australian business group.



We operate a couple of different businesses, including cleaning services and property management. There are a lot of transactions, invoices, contractor payments and moving parts, so this is not a basic data-entry bookkeeping role.



We need someone who understands **Xero**, knows how to keep financial records accurate and organised, and takes ownership of making sure things are actually completed — not simply entered into a system.



You’ll work closely with someone currently managing these processes, who will train you on our systems and gradually hand over responsibility.



## What You’ll Be Doing



- Managing bookkeeping in Xero

- Creating, reviewing and sending client invoices

- Preparing weekly contractor payments and ABA files

- Reconciling bank accounts and transactions

- Following up overdue invoices and sending statements

- Recording and investigating overpayments, credits and payment discrepancies

- Assisting with payroll

- Supporting BAS preparation and working with our accountant

- Maintaining accurate financial records across our internal systems and Google Sheets

- Following up internally when information is missing or something doesn’t reconcile

- Helping manage trust accounting processes for our property management operations

- Keeping clear records of what has been completed, what is pending and what requires attention

- Identifying errors or inconsistencies rather than simply processing what is in front of you

- Helping improve finance and bookkeeping processes as the businesses grow



## Trust Accounting



An important part of our future property management operations involves **managing money belonging to property owners**, so trust accounting knowledge is particularly valuable to us.



If you have direct trust accounting experience — especially Australian property management trust accounting — we definitely want to hear about it.



**If you don’t, please still apply if the rest of your bookkeeping experience is strong. Just tell us honestly what experience you do or don’t have.** We value honesty much more than an applicant trying to tick every box.



## You’ll Be a Great Fit If You



- Have strong practical experience using **Xero**

- Have solid bookkeeping knowledge and understand the reasoning behind what you are doing

- Have experience with reconciliations, invoicing, accounts receivable and accounts payable

- Have excellent attention to detail

- Are confident investigating something when the numbers don’t make sense

- Are highly organised and systematic

- Follow tasks through until they are actually finished

- Communicate clearly in written English

- Are comfortable chasing information from other team members when needed

- Can work independently without constant supervision

- Are trustworthy and understand the responsibility involved in handling financial information

- Are comfortable with Google Sheets and learning internal systems

- Ideally have experience working with Australian businesses

- Ideally have trust accounting experience



## Availability



This is intended to be your **primary and exclusive full-time professional commitment**.



Because you will be handling important financial processes and working Brisbane business hours, this role is not suitable for someone planning to manage another full-time job, regular VA role or ongoing client work alongside this position.



## Your Setup



You need:



- Your own desktop or laptop

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Backup internet

- Backup power, or reliable access to another working location during outages

- A quiet and professional home working environment



## What We Offer



- Long-term, stable full-time work

- Weekly payments

- 13th-month pay (pro-rata)

- 4 weeks paid leave (accumulative or payable)

- Training and handover from the person currently managing the processes

- Opportunity to take genuine ownership of the finance function as our businesses grow

- A warm, supportive and growing team



# HOW TO APPLY – PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Send your application to:







Your
 subject **MUST include the word:**



# BALANCE



If **BALANCE** is not included in your
 subject, your application will not be reviewed.



Please put your **cover letter in the body of the
** — not as an attachment or external link — and attach your CV as a PDF.



**Important**: Applications submitted through this platform will not be reviewed. To be considered for this role, you must apply by
 following the instructions below.



Keep your answers short and direct:



1. Where in the Philippines are you currently based?

2. How many years of bookkeeping experience do you have?

3. How many years have you used Xero professionally?

4. Have you worked for an Australian business before? If yes, doing what?

5. Describe your trust accounting experience. If you have none, simply write **“No direct trust accounting experience.”**

6. Have you prepared ABA files, payroll or assisted with BAS? Briefly explain.

7. Tell us about one bookkeeping discrepancy or error you discovered yourself. What was wrong?

8. Are you currently employed, freelancing, running a business, or working with any other clients? If yes, please briefly explain your current commitments.

9. If selected, would you be able to make this role your only ongoing professional commitment during the agreed working hours?

10. When could you start?



### Attention-to-detail question



An invoice for **$1,485.00** was issued to a client. The client a
 paid **$1,845.00**.



In 2–3 sentences, tell us what you would do next.

title: Amazon Creative Strategist
description:
APPLY -> 



ABOUT FLAPEN



Flapen is an Amazon growth company. We launch and scale brands end to end — product research, positioning, creative, listings, and ads — for sellers who want to compete with operators far larger than they are. Every launch starts with our own research platform: proprietary market data that d
 which niches are worth entering before a dollar goes into inventory.



Most Amazon brands lose on the shelf before anyone reads a word of their listing. Our work is to make sure that doesn't happen: sharper positioning, main images that earn the click, listings that convert the traffic they get.



300+ Amazon product launches run end to end

Founded by an operator with 8+ years building and scaling Amazon brands



ROLE

We're hiring a Creative Strategist to own creative for a portfolio of client brands on Amazon. It starts before the listing: you define the brand from its target audience up — who it's for, what it stands against, how it looks and how it sounds — and every asset after that inherits it. You don't design and you don't edit. You d
 what the creative says, to whom and why, and the angle, the test roadmap and the call on what we kill are yours.



What makes this different from a standard Amazon creative seat: you're building identity and conversion in the same job. Packaging and positioning are yours, and so is the main image that has to win a click against nine competitors in a grid. Then you have to prove it — CTR, CVR and ROAS, measured against the asset you replaced rather than argued from taste. This is for someone who has already carried a portfolio, not someone who wants to learn portfolio work on ours.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own creative strategy for a portfolio of client brands on Amazon — main image, secondary set, A+ content, packaging and video.

- Define each brand from its target audience up: who actually buys, what they're d
 between, and the objection that kills the sale. A working document, not a persona deck.

- Set the identity that follows from it — logo direction, packaging, palette, tone of voice, and the claims we lead with.

- Write the briefs the creative team builds from — angle, hook, proof, objection, reference — specific enough that nobody has to ask a follow-up question.

- Run the A/B testing roadmap: hypothesis and kill number written before launch, winner called from the data, and a readout that says what we keep and what we kill.

- Direct the organic Instagram creative for the brands you run — the same identity, cut for a feed instead of a listing. Paid social is a separate seat and inherits the brand rules you set.

- Mine the inputs nobody else has time for — reviews, competitor gaps, category conventions — and turn them into angles worth testing.



RESULTS

- First briefs shipped and live accounts owned inside 30 days.

- Every brand in the portfolio has a current identity and messaging framework the whole creative team works from.

- No brand goes a full month without a live test. Every test carries a hypothesis and a kill number written before launch, and a recorded result whether it wins or dies.

- CTR and CVR improve on the accounts you own, measured against the control the asset replaced — and ad ROAS improves with them.

- Nothing runs quietly. Losing creative is replaced on the schedule it was given, and no finished test sits unread.

- Briefs stand on their own — the creative team starts building without a clarification call, and revision rounds drop over time.

- Creative decisions trace back to a stated hypothesis and a measured result, not to opinion. The brief queue runs without founder review; readouts and real escalations are the only things that come up.



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years owning Amazon creative strategy for multiple brands at once, at an agency or independently, with the listings and the results they produced available to show.

- Has built a brand identity from nothing, not just executed inside someone else's — positioning, packaging and visual system for a product that had none.

- Diagnoses from metrics, not taste. Given CTR, CVR and ROAS you can say whether it's an image problem, an offer problem or a traffic problem — and you know a winner called from two weeks of thin traffic is noise.

- Writes clearly under pressure, with briefs you can send us. Most of this job is writing, and a brief that needs a call to explain is a failed brief.

- Self-directed and async. You commit to positioning without waiting for a sign-off.



BONUS POINTS

- Hands-on with Amazon split testing — Manage Your Experiments, Splitly or PickFu.

- Have directed organic social creative for a consumer brand, not only listing assets.

- Packaging design direction: dielines, print-ready handoff, 3D mockups in Pacdora.

- Have worked alongside a media buyer and know where creative accountability ends and media accountability starts.



LOCATION & HOURS

- Remote.

- Async by default. 40-hour week across five 8-hour days. At least 6 hours of each day overlap Dubai time (GST, UTC+4).

- We track hours. That log is how your pay is calculated.

- Your rate, your scope and your promotion are d
 on outcomes — what you shipped, what it moved in CTR and conversion, and what that movement was worth in revenue to the brand.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully remote, permanently. No return-to-office plans, because there is no office to return to.

- Ownership of your projects with zero micromanagement. You are briefed on the outcome, not the steps.

- A fixed annual paid time off allowance.

- Budget for tools, courses and AI subscriptions you can make a case for.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through the link below. You'll be asked to record a short introduction video — it takes about five minutes and it's the fastest way for us to see how you think. Applications sent as messages on the job board are not reviewed.

title: Customer Service & Operations Coordinator (M-F)
description:
CUSTOMER SERVICE & OPERATIONS COORDINATOR



Customer Support • Delivery Logistics • Shopify Order Management



ABOUT US



We are a fast-growing U.S.-based e-commerce and local delivery company serving customers in the cannabis industry. We are looking for an exceptional Customer Service & Operations Coordinator to help manage customer communication, order coordination, delivery logistics, payment confirmation, Shopify order monitoring, and daily operational support.



This is a remote position with significant responsibility. While customer service is the primary focus, this role also involves coordinating deliveries, monitoring Shopify orders, communicating with drivers, confirming payments, helping with product availability updates, and keeping daily operations running smoothly.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term. As our company continues to expand, there will be opportunities for increased responsibility and career advancement.



Candidates must be comfortable working with a U.S.-based local delivery service that operates in the cannabis industry and serves age-restricted customers.



SCHEDULE



Monday–Friday



Approximately 9:00 AM–6:30 PM Eastern Time



This is a live operations role. While your scheduled shift ends around 6:30 PM, our priority is ensuring customers are taken care of and operations are properly wrapped up. Some days you may finish on time, while busier days may require staying a little later to complete active customer issues, deliveries, payment confirmations, or important operational handoffs.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is primarily a customer service position, but it also carries important operational responsibilities.



Throughout your shift, you will serve as the central point of coordination between customers, drivers, dispatch, fulfillment, and our internal team. You will help ensure orders move smoothly from purchase through delivery while providing excellent customer support every step of the way.



Because of the nature of our business, accuracy, professionalism, confidentiality, and following company procedures are extremely important. Small mistakes can have significant operational consequences, so we are looking for someone who takes pride in getting the details right.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Customer Service



- Respond to customer inquiries professionally and promptly.

- Confirm order details, payment status, and delivery information.

- Keep customers informed throughout the order process.

- Send payment instructions using company-approved templates.

- Confirm receipt of payment before orders are fulfilled or dispatched.

- Communicate product substitutions, replacements, or out-of-stock items when needed.

- Resolve customer concerns using company procedures and communication templates.

- Escalate complex customer issues, delivery concerns, or fulfillment problems when necessary.



Operations & Logistics



- Monitor incoming Shopify orders throughout your shift.

- Review order details for accuracy, including customer information, products ordered, delivery method, and payment status.

- Coordinate local deliveries with drivers and dispatch.

- Assign or help coordinate orders based on delivery area, driver availability, and order requirements.

- Track order progress from payment through fulfillment and delivery.

- Help ensure deliveries are completed accurately and on time.

- Monitor shipping, courier, and local delivery status.

- Assist with payment confirmations and operational record keeping.

- Help resolve delivery delays, driver availability issues, customer address problems, or order-related concerns.



Shopify & Administrative Support



- Perform basic Shopify order management.

- Assist with updating product availability and inventory when needed.

- Help notify the team when products are low in stock or out of stock.

- Assist with product listing updates when needed, including product details, photos, pricing, descriptions, or availability.

- Check product pages for errors, missing information, incorrect pricing, or inaccurate availability.

- Help maintain organized records for orders, deliveries, payments, and inventory updates.

- Complete clear shift handoffs for any open orders, pending customer conversations, delivery issues, payment confirmations, or ongoing operational tasks.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys keeping operations organized.



The ideal candidate:



- Has exceptional customer service skills.

- Is extremely detail-oriented and organized.

- Can confidently manage multiple priorities at once.

- Communicates professionally with customers, drivers, and teammates.

- Takes ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do.

- Remains calm under pressure.

- Learns systems quickly and follows procedures consistently.

- Understands the importance of accuracy and confidentiality.

- Is dependable, responsive, and accountable.

- Is comfortable working with a company in the cannabis industry.



Although this is not a management title, this role carries a high level of responsibility. You will play a key part in coordinating daily operations and helping ensure everything runs smoothly.



QUALIFICATIONS



Required



- Excellent written and verbal English.

- Strong customer service experience.

- Outstanding attention to detail.

- Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Ability to follow procedures, templates, and company instructions carefully.

- Reliable computer and high-speed internet.

- Availability Monday–Friday during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- Comfort working with a U.S.-based e-commerce and local delivery company in the cannabis industry.



Preferred



- Logistics, dispatch, or delivery coordination experience.

- Shopify experience.

- E-commerce operations experience.

- Order fulfillment experience.

- Experience supporting U.S.-based customers.

- Experience working in a remote operations environment.

- Experience coordinating with drivers, couriers, dispatch teams, or delivery services.

- Experience with inventory updates, product availability, or product listings.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



- You struggle to stay organized while managing multiple tasks.

- You frequently overlook small details.

- You need constant supervision or direction.

- You become overwhelmed in fast-paced environments.

- You prefer repetitive work with little responsibility.

- You are uncomfortable working with a company in the cannabis industry.

- You stop working simply because the scheduled shift has ended while important customer or operational issues are still active.



COMPENSATION



Compensation is based on experience, communication skills, customer service background, Shopify experience, operational experience, schedule availability, and overall fit.



Please include your desired hourly rate when applying.



HOW TO APPLY



To help us identify candidates who pay attention to detail, please begin your application with the word “LOGISTICS.”



Please answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about your customer service experience.

2. Describe any experience you have coordinating deliveries, logistics, dispatch, or operations.

3. What experience do you have using Shopify or other e-commerce platforms?

4. Tell us about a time you had to manage several urgent priorities at once. How did you stay organized?

5. A customer has already paid for an order, but one item is unexpectedly out of stock. How would you handle the situation?

6. A delivery driver stops responding while completing an active delivery. What steps would you take?

7. Are you comfortable working with a U.S.-based local delivery company serving customers in the cannabis industry?

8. Why do you believe you would be a great fit for this position?

9. What is your desired hourly rate?



We look forward to hearing from you!
