title: Accountant
description:
We are an Australian financial advisory company seeking a highly capable Offshore Accountant to support our accounting operations. We are looking for someone with solid Australian company experience, strong attention to detail, and advanced hands-on experience using Xero platform. 



This role is ideal for an accountant who is confident working independently, understand Australian business and tax processes, and can deliver accurate, timely, and insightful financial support. 



Key Responsibilities: 

- Structure, manage, and track client or business rebates. 

- Process employee payments, including monthly and fortnightly payroll support. 

- Manage cash flow monitoring and reporting. 

- Perform bank reconciliations and general account reconciliation. 

- Support and coordinate audit requirements and documentation. 

- Manage Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes. 

- Assist with budgeting and forecasting activities. 

- Prepare management reports and provide financial insights. 

- Liaise with internal stakeholders and external parties on tax-related matters. 

- Maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely processing of transactions. 

- Identify process improvements to enhance finance efficiency and accuracy. 



Required Experience and Skills: 

- Proven experience working with Australian companies or within an Australian accounting/finance environment. 

- Strong practical experience using Xero, including reconciliations, AP/AR, reporting, and general ledger management. 

- Experience in payroll processing, including monthly and fortnightly payment cycles. 

- Solid understanding of core accounting processes, including reconciliations, cash flow, payables, and receivables. 

- Experience supporting audits and preparing finance-related documentation. 

- Good understanding of Australian business and finance practices. 

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. 

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. 

- Ability to work remotely, manage deadlines, and maintain confidentiality. 



Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience in a professional services, financial advisory, accounting, or similar Australian business environment. 

- Exposure to Australian tax or compliance-related processes. 

- Accounting qualification, bookkeeping certification, or equivalent relevant experience. 

- Ability to provide financial insights beyond transactional processing. 



What We Are Looking For: 

- Reliable, proactive, and organised. 

- Comfortable working with an Australian team and Australian business standards. 

- Able to take ownership of finance tasks with minimal supervision. 

- Process-driven, accurate, and committed to meeting deadlines.

title: Amazon Influencer VA and Video Editor
description:

This role supports Amazon content creators and online entrepreneurs as they grow their businesses and expand their teams. The position combines content management, video editing, product research, brand outreach, and administrative support.



We are looking for a process-oriented professional with strong written and spoken English who follows documented workflows and checklists accurately and consistently. Communication is just as important as technical skill. The ideal candidate speaks up, shares thoughtful feedback, asks questions when needed, and flags potential issues early.



Successful candidates must complete a paid 40-hour training program before transitioning to their assigned client. Training is paid at a flat rate of $125 USD and runs from September 28 - October 2, 2026, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM PHT, including a one-hour lunch break. Full attendance, active participation, and completion of all learning assessments are required.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Edit product review videos while consistently following established procedures, brand standards, and quality-control checklists

- Manage and maintain published product content, including videos, product links, collections, and page organization

- Research potential products for reviews and track products, videos, and content opportunities

- Assist with content planning, organization, and workflow management

- Upload, schedule, publish, and update content across designated platforms

- Repurpose and cross-post content across YouTube and social media platforms

- Create simple graphics, thumbnails, and visual assets using Canva

- Organize footage, creative assets, documents, and project files

- Communicate with brands and assist with outreach, follow-ups, and partnership coordination

- Maintain spreadsheets, databases, and operational trackers



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills - this is a must

- Strong attention to detail and a consistent ability to follow documented processes and checklists accurately

- At least 1 year of video editing experience, including long-form videos and short-form repurposing

- Intermediate proficiency in CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar software

- Sufficient computer storage and specifications to download and run the Descript desktop app

- Experience with content scheduling, publishing, or content management

- Experience managing content across YouTube, Instagram,
, Pinterest, and TikTok

- Proficiency in Canva and a basic understanding of graphic design principles

- Proficiency in Google Workspace, including Docs, Sheets, and Drive

- Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills

- Confident communicator who proactively raises questions, flags issues, and offers constructive feedback

- Proven ability to work independently, consistently meet deadlines, and quickly learn new systems and tools

- Reliable high-speed internet connection of at least 100 Mbps and a professional remote work setup

- Must be comfortable with Hubstaff installed and used for productivity monitoring, time tracking, and payroll



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience using Descript for video editing

- Experience supporting content creators, influencers, or online businesses

- Experience editing product review and comparison videos

- Background in administrative support, content coordination, social media support, or community management

- Experience with brand outreach or partnership coordination

- Familiarity with affiliate marketing, e-commerce, or the Amazon Influencer Program



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



- $500 to $600 USD per month, depending on experience and skills

- Paid 40-hour training program at a flat rate of $125 USD

- Paid Time Off

- Paid sick days

- Paid Philippine regular holidays

- 13th month pay (pro-rated if applicable)

- Flexible working hours, Monday-Friday, with 1 hour of overlap daily around 5:00-6:00 PM Eastern Time (5:00-6:00 AM Philippine Time)

- Long-term opportunity with room for professional growth



*Final compensation, schedule, and benefits may vary based on the outcome of the client interview



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit all the following required materials:



- To confirm that you have read the entire job post, use the job code listed above as your application subject line

- Updated resume highlighting your relevant work experience

- A 1 to 2-minute video introduction

- Portfolio showcasing relevant work. Portfolios must include at least one video-editing sample.

- Screenshot of your computer specifications with the System Information visible:

  - Windows: Intel Core i7, 10th Generation or newer, or AMD Ryzen 7, 5000 Series or newer

  - Mac: Apple M1 or newer

- Internet speed test screenshot from Speedtest.net

  - Minimum of 100 Mbps download and upload speed

WHAT YOU WILL DO

We care about:



• Qualified accounts researched • Decision-makers identified • Relationship paths discovered • Target accounts contacted • Real conversations • Appointments and walkthroughs • Vendor opportunities • Quotes/bids • First jobs • Repeat jobs • Recurring accounts • Revenue generated from acquired accounts



We do NOT consider followers, likes, impressions, number of posts, scraped leads, or mass
s to be the primary measure of success.

• B2B prospecting and account research • Decision-maker/contact research • Lead generation and qualification • Telephone prospecting • Appointment setting • Objection handling • Personalized

ACCOUNT GROWTH

title: [Cebu/Lapu-Lapu Based] Freelance Traditional / Analog Illustrator - GCash Pay
description:
# Overview

We are seeking passionate Traditional Illustrators and Artists who can meticulously replicate and trace digital sample images onto paper using physical art mediums. 



This is a remote, freelance, and project-based position, but it is STRICTLY LIMITED to candidates who can ship or deliver finished physical artworks to our office in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu. Even if you are an entry-level artist, you are welcome to apply as long as you can draw accurately and carefully.



# Key Responsibilities

- Hand-draw and color characters, compositions, and backgrounds on A4-size paper based on the digital sample images provided.

- Faithfully replicate the original composition, character details, clothing, expressions, coloring, and shading (No need to create original concepts).

- Finish the artwork completely by hand (Digital artwork/digital printing is NOT accepted).

- Submit digital scans or clear photos for review before shipping, and deliver the physical drawings to our Lapu-Lapu City office once approved.



# Required Paper & Art Supplies

- Paper: A4 size (210×297mm) Kent paper, watercolor paper, or any paper suitable for your art mediums.

- Mediums: Mechanical pencils, pencils, Copic markers, watercolors, colored pencils, etc.

*Note: All costs for paper, art supplies, and materials are already fully included in the compensation rates below.*



# Quality Review & Shipping Workflow

1. **Pre-Shipping Review:** Before sending the physical artwork, you must send a high-quality digital scan or clear, well-lit photo of the finished drawing via
 for our evaluation and quality check.

2. **Approval & Revision:** If any adjustments are needed, revisions must be made. Once the artwork is approved, you may proceed to shipping.

3. **Bulk Delivery:** To minimize handling and effort, you will batch and ship/deliver 3 to 5 completed drawings together (approximately one week's worth of work) at one time.

4. **Delivery Method:** Physical artworks must be protected against bending, water damage, and stains. You can ship them via local couriers (e.g., LBC, JRS Express, J&T Express) or deliver them via on-demand delivery apps (e.g., Lalamove, Grab) to our Lapu-Lapu City office. 

*(Note: Local shipping and delivery fees are already fully included in the compensation rates below).*



# Compensation (Paid via GCash)

1. **Trial Phase (First 3 drawings):** 150 PHP per drawing.

2. **Official Hire Phase:** 250 PHP to 400 PHP per finished drawing.

- Rate increases based on quality, performance, and duration of the contract.

- All rates are flat-rate and fully inclusive of paper, art supplies, and local shipping/delivery fees.

- Payment will be processed via GCash.



# Rights, Confidentiality & Prohibited Actions

- Upon inspection and payment, all ownership, copyrights, and commercial rights of the artwork will transfer to our company.

- Posting the sample images, finished artworks, or copies on social media, portfolios, or utilizing them as work samples for other companies is strictly prohibited. All project details are subject to strict non-disclosure.

- Unauthorized use or distribution of the original source images or providing samples to any third party will result in immediate termination.



# How to Apply

Please apply with the following details:

1. Brief self-introduction.

2. Art mediums you use and are best at.

3. Your availability for long-term continuous work (How many drawings can you finish per week?).

4. Confirmation of agreement regarding rates, shipping workflow, and confidentiality terms.

5. **Samples of your past traditional artwork:** Please attach scanned images or clear photos of your drawings/sketches.
salary: 250 PHP to 400 PHP per finished drawing

title: Head of Marketplace (Amazon Sales)
description:
Truegenics Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based e-commerce company with a track record of more than US$218 million in online product sales. We develop and market our own brands of health supplements and beauty products to customers around the world.



As we continue to grow our Amazon business, we are looking for a commercially strong and hands-on Head of Marketplace for Amazon Sales to take ownership of the channel across our portfolio of brands.



Mission of the Role: The Head of Marketplace for Amazon Sales will be responsible for independently running and growing Truegenics’ Amazon business. You will own Amazon channel performance across revenue, profitability, advertising, marketplace execution, product launches, inventory health and day-to-day commercial decision-making.



This is a hands-on role. We are looking for someone who can set direction, identify what is driving or limiting performance, make sound commercial decisions and personally step into the details when required. Success will be measured by the ability to grow Amazon profitably, solve problems proactively and build a more scalable and effective Amazon operation.



Key Responsibilities



Amazon P&L & Growth

- Own Amazon revenue, profitability, advertising efficiency, pricing, promotions and overall channel performance across multiple brands

- Develop growth plans, forecasts and targets and identify the highest-impact opportunities to improve revenue and profitability.

- Regularly assess performance and make clear recommendations on where to invest, optimise or change direction.



Advertising & Marketplace Performance

- Own Amazon PPC and advertising performance, including ACOS, TACOS, ROAS and overall advertising profitability.

- Improve organic rankings, traffic and conversion through keyword strategy, listing optimisation, content, pricing, promotions and reviews.

- Maintain strong account and marketplace health and resolve material Seller Central, listing, compliance or operational issues.



Product & Portfolio Growth

- Lead Amazon launches for new products and brands, including keyword strategy, advertising, inventory, pricing, reviews and ranking.

- Monitor ASIN-level performance and identify which products should be scaled, improved, repositioned or deprioritised.

- Stay close to category, competitor and marketplace developments and translate these into commercial actions.



Inventory & Commercial Planning

- Work closely with Supply Chain and Finance to align sales forecasts, inventory purchasing and FBA requirements.

- Maintain healthy stock availability while managing inventory turns, excess inventory, storage costs and cash-flow considerations.

- Anticipate inventory requirements arising from growth, promotions, launches and seasonality.



Team, Systems & Reporting

- Lead the small Amazon team and manage external agencies or specialist partners where appropriate.

- Set clear priorities, KPIs and accountability for the resources supporting Amazon.

- Build practical SOPs, dashboards and operating processes that improve consistency and allow the channel to scale.

- Provide management with concise reporting that explains what happened, why it happened and what actions should be taken next.

- Use AI, automation and technology to improve productivity, accelerate analysis and decision-making, and continuously improve Amazon performance and operating efficiency. 



Key Requirements

- 5–8 years of relevant e-commerce, marketplace or digital commerce experience, with meaningful responsibility for Amazon.

- At least 3 years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience, preferably within the US marketplace.

- Proven ability to grow Amazon revenue and improve commercial performance.

- Experience managing or materially influencing Amazon P&L, including revenue, margins, advertising spend, pricing and forecasting.

- Strong knowledge of Amazon PPC, ACOS/TACOS, keyword strategy, rankings, listing optimisation and conversion.

- Good understanding of Amazon FBA, inventory planning and marketplace operations.

- Experience managing multiple products and/or brands.

- Strong analytical ability and comfort working with Excel/Google Sheets, dashboards and performance data.

- Commercially minded and able to balance growth, profitability, inventory and cash-flow considerations.

- Hands-on, proactive and comfortable solving problems without waiting for detailed direction.

- Able to lead a small team and work effectively across Supply Chain, Finance, Creative and other internal functions.



Experience in supplements, health, beauty or other competitive consumer categories would be advantageous.



The Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate operates like the owner of the Amazon channel.



When performance changes, you do not simply report the numbers. You investigate what caused the change and determine whether the issue is advertising, conversion, ranking, pricing, inventory, competition or the product itself.



You are comfortable moving between strategy and execution. You can build a growth plan, review channel profitability, challenge an agency, analyse an underperforming product and go directly into Seller Central when required.



You actively use AI, automation and technology to work smarter, move faster and improve performance, while applying sound commercial judgment to the outputs. 



You do not need a large team or extensive layers of support to get things done. You are resourceful, commercially sharp and comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment.



Most importantly, you take ownership. You see yourself as accountable for growing the Amazon business profitably and not simply managing the activities around it.



Why Join Us



This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of an important growth channel within an established international e-commerce company.



You will have the autonomy to shape how we grow Amazon, influence product and investment decisions, improve the way the channel operates and build a stronger Amazon business across multiple Truegenics brands.



Note: The role will initially be offered on a 6-month contract, with the opportunity for permanent employment subject to successful performance.

title: ON-SITE, EVERY WORKING DAY — Operations / Production Manager, Small Video Editing Team (City Open — Philippines)
description:
ON-SITE, EVERY WORKING DAY — Operations / Production Manager, Small Video Editing Team (City Open — Philippines)



We are a US-based media company that produces long-form YouTube content at scale. We are opening a small, dedicated editing office in the Philippines and looking for ONE strong manager to run it.



City is open. We'll base the office wherever the person we hire already has a team they can pull from and a building that meets our standard. This is primarily a people-and-operations role, with hands-on editing as a backup skill — not a full-time editing job.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Recruit and build a team of 3-5 video editors in your city

- Help choose and set up the office — evaluating buildings against our spec, coordinating move-in, and getting the workspace ready

- Manage the daily workflow: assign work, hold deadlines, keep quality consistent

- Train the team to our style and standards (we provide the system and the scripts)

- Judge editing quality and catch issues before they ship

- Step in and edit yourself when someone is out sick, or when something urgent needs to get done — not a daily requirement

- Manage the workspace, the equipment and attendance

- Report once a day to our team abroad — you are our person on the ground



THE 3-WEEK TARGET

What we mean by this: 3 weeks from your start date to having the office running with 3 editors actively working in it. That covers choosing the building, getting equipment set up, recruiting editors, and onboarding them — not 3 weeks until you personally walk through the door.



That said, quality matters more than hitting the number exactly. We would rather have week 4 with three good editors than week 3 with two good ones and one warm body rushed in to hit a deadline. The last two hires especially are judged on fit and quality, not just speed.



This is exactly why an existing network of editors in your city is a real advantage — recruiting from a cold start while also setting up an office in 3 weeks is genuinely difficult.



WHAT WE NEED

- ON-SITE, EVERY WORKING DAY. This is not remote and not hybrid — if you cannot commit to being physically present every working day, please do not apply

- An existing network of video editors in your city you can bring in quickly — tell us who, how many, and where

- A building in your city that can meet our office spec (see below) — tell us if you already have somewhere in mind

- Experience as a team lead, lead editor, or someone who has supervised editors, managed workflow, or done QA/review on a team's output — tell us what that looked like

- Basic-to-solid hands-on video editing ability — enough to judge quality and step in when needed. You do NOT need to be a world-class editor or edit every day. Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects preferred. Tell us what software you use and share a portfolio/reel

- Excellent English, written and spoken

- Comfortable with project management tools (ClickUp, Trello, Asana or similar)

- NBI clearance and at least 2 references we can actually call



THE OFFICE SPEC

Wherever the office ends up, the building must have:

- Security with controlled access

- Backup power

- Fast, redundant internet

- A private, lockable room for the team

- 24/7 access

- Daily cleaning



NICE TO HAVE

- Recruiting or hiring experience

- Experience with YouTube content

- Experience working inside a seat-lease / BPO facility



WHAT WE OFFER

- PHP 55,000 - 70,000 per month depending on experience

- Full-time, long-term, on-site

- You build your own team and grow with the office as it expands

- Every editor on the team is hired individually and paid individually and directly by us

- We are in the process of setting up formal business registration in the Philippines



HOW TO APPLY

Put the word TEAM at the top of your reply so we know you read this ad. Then send:

1. Your city, and a short note about a team or workflow you led, supervised, or did QA on, and how many people were involved

2. Your CV and a portfolio or reel showing your own long-form YouTube editing work

3. Your answer to this question: how would you recruit 4 good video editors in your city within 3 weeks?

4. Tell us about any editors you already know in your city and could bring in quickly, and whether you have a building in mind that fits our spec



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a small paid test/trial task before a final decision.



Applications without the word TEAM at the top will not be reviewed.

PAY

Starting salary: $
/month, based on your experience and how the test video goes.

Salary reviewed at 3 months and again at 6 months.

Strong performers reach $800+/month within the first year.

- 13th month pay.

- We pay for every software subscription you need.



WHO WE WANT



- You can open a web app you have never seen and work out how it works, without us explaining every step

- Clear spoken English, neutral accent

- Quiet room and a decent USB microphone

WHO WE DO NOT WANT

HOW TO APPLY



We read every application that does all five. We skip the rest.

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer (Ecommerce)
description:
APPLY -> 



ABOUT FLAPEN

Flapen is an Amazon growth company. We launch and scale brands end to end — product research, positioning, creative, listings, and ads — for sellers who want to compete with operators far larger than they are. Every launch starts with our own research platform: proprietary market data that d
 which niches are worth entering before a dollar goes into inventory.

Most Amazon brands lose on the shelf before anyone reads a word of their listing. Our work is to make sure that doesn't happen: sharper positioning, main images that earn the click, listings that convert the traffic they get.

- 300+ Amazon product launches run end to end

- Founded by an operator with 8+ years building and scaling Amazon brands



ROLE

We're hiring a Paid Social Buyer to lead off-channel growth for a portfolio of established Amazon brands. These are products with real sales history and little to no presence outside Amazon. The work is opening that second channel and turning it into traffic, customers and revenue the listing alone was never going to produce. You start with one brand and add more as the channel proves out.

What makes this different from a standard DTC seat: a large share of the sales you drive will land on Amazon, where Meta can't see them and will report you as unprofitable while you're actually making money. You're expected to know that trap, build the attribution around it, and argue for budget on total revenue over total spend.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build Meta and Instagram advertising for several brands from near zero. A few have a page or an old ad account, none have real traction — you're starting the channel, not inheriting it.

- D
 which brand gets the next dollar. Move budget between the brands every week and say why.

- Build the testing system: test angles, audiences, offers and landing pages. Write the hypothesis and the kill number before the campaign goes live.

- Take what wins on one brand and test it on the others the same week.

- Brief the creative team on paid social assets — hook, format, angle — inside the brand framework the Creative Strategist sets, and approve the asset before money goes behind it.

- Set up tracking that catches sales landing on Amazon, where Meta can't see them and will report you as unprofitable.

- Report weekly on blended MER — total revenue divided by total ad spend — and what you changed because of it.



RESULTS

- One brand reaches its target blended MER inside 90 days, with the winning angle, audience and creative format documented well enough for someone else to run it again.

- Testing is continuous and documented — at least 4 new angles per live brand per month, each with a hypothesis and a kill number written before launch, and the result recorded whether it wins or dies.

- Blended MER is tracked from day one — and improves month over month.

- Spend is always accounted for. Zero budget overruns, and no campaign left running past its stated kill number unreviewed.

- The creative queue never runs dry — the creative team always knows what's next and why.

- Reporting is automated, weekly, and decision-ready.

- Paid social becomes a measurable, growing revenue driver for the portfolio — on Shopify and in the Amazon halo it creates.



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years buying Meta and Instagram ads for physical consumer products, including at least one brand you took from zero to consistently profitable spend above $10,000 per month.

- Can explain why platform-reported ROAS and blended MER disagree, and which one you act on.

- Able to write a creative brief a creative team can execute without a call — hook, format, angle, and the objection the ad has to beat.

- Advanced Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager — campaign structure, bidding, audiences, and attribution setup.

- Self-directed and async. You set the testing cadence and report without being asked.



BONUS POINTS

- Have driven off-Amazon traffic to an Amazon listing and measured the halo — Amazon Attribution, Levanta, or Brand Referral Bonus.

- Experience working closely with creative strategists, designers, video editors, and copywriters.

- Knowledge of landing-page optimization and conversion-rate optimization.

- TikTok ads experience.



LOCATION & HOURS

- Remote.

- Async by default. 40-hour week across five 8-hour days. At least 6 hours of each day overlap Dubai time (GST, UTC+4).

- We track hours. That log is how your pay is calculated.

- Your rate, your scope and your promotion are d
 on outcomes — what you shipped, what it moved in MER and acquisition cost, and what that movement was worth in revenue to the brand.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive pay, performance bonuses, and career growth opportunities

- Fully remote, permanently. No return-to-office plans, because there is no office to return to.

- Ownership of your projects with zero micromanagement. You are briefed on the outcome, not the steps.

- A fixed annual paid time off allowance.

- Budget for tools, courses and AI subscriptions you can make a case for.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through the link. You'll be asked to record a short introduction video — it takes about five minutes and it's the fastest way for us to see how you think. Applications sent as messages on the job board are not reviewed.

Philippine Standard Time, with a **two-hour overlap with Australian Eastern Time** so we can talk through revisions live. Full-time or part-time — tell us which you want.

PLEASE ADVISE YOUR RATE

title: Customer Support Agent — DTC Supplement Brand (Subscription, High Volume, Phone + Email)
description:
Read carefully — this is a high-volume, high-standard support role.



We're a fast-growing DTC supplement brand running a subscription-first model with a large, active customer base. That means a lot of tickets, a lot of subscription questions, and customers who need fast, warm, accurate answers — over both
 and phone. We're hiring several experienced CS agents who can handle real volume without dropping quality.



This is not an entry-level role. If you've done real customer support for an ecommerce or subscription brand, your spoken and written English are excellent, and you're fast, empathetic, and unflappable, keep reading.



What you'll do



Handle a high volume of customer tickets daily —
, chat, and helpdesk

Handle phone support — speaking with customers directly, calmly, and clearly

Manage subscription issues: cancellations, pauses, skips, billing questions, failed payments, refunds

Handle chargebacks, disputes, and difficult customers calmly and professionally

Resolve shipping, tracking, and delivery inquiries

Follow our support scripts, policies, and escalation rules precisely

Keep response times fast and quality high, even under heavy load



Who we're looking for (strict requirements)



Proven CS experience for an ecommerce or DTC brand — not general call-center only. You understand online-store customers.

Experience with subscription/recurring-billing businesses — you understand rebills, cancellations, dunning, and how to handle a frustrated subscriber. This is essential.

Experience in the supplement / health / wellness space strongly preferred — you know how to talk to this customer and stay compliant (no medical claims).

Excellent English — written AND spoken. Our customers are US-based and mostly older, and this role includes phone support, so we need a clear, warm, easy-to-understand speaking voice with a neutral accent — not just strong writing. Tone and clarity on the phone matter as much as on
.

Hands-on with a helpdesk / ticketing tool — Gorgias, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Freshdesk or similar. Gorgias experience is a big plus.

Fast and accurate under volume — you can handle many tickets a day without sloppy replies.

Calm with angry or difficult customers — de-escalation is a core skill.

Reliable, self-managing, and available consistently for full coverage (we run support across extended hours, including weekends — flexibility required).



Bonus (stand out)



Experience with Shopify, chargeback handling, or fraud/dispute management

Experience writing or improving support macros/templates

Comfortable with high-empathy, older US customer demographics



Why this role



We treat CS as core to the business, not an afterthought. Strong agents get stability, growth, and a long-term role on a team that's scaling fast. We start with a paid trial so we both confirm the fit.



How to apply (follow exactly — this is the first filter)



Start your application with the word "RESOLVE" as the very first word. Applications without it are deleted unread.

In 2–3 sentences, describe the most difficult customer situation you've handled and how you resolved it.

Answer this: A customer messages angry that they were charged for a subscription they say they forgot about, and they're threatening a chargeback. How do you respond? (Give us your actual reply to the customer.)

Include a short voice sample. Record 30–60 seconds of you speaking in English — either introducing yourself, or (better) reading this as if to a customer: "Hi, thank you for calling HydroLabs, my name is ___. I completely understand your concern about the charge, and I'm going to help you sort this out right now." Send it as an audio file or link (Loom, Google Drive, WhatsApp voice note, etc.). Applications without a voice sample won't be considered.

Tell us: which helpdesk tools you've used, and whether you've worked with subscription and/or supplement brands (name them if you can).

No AI-written applications. We want to see how you actually write to a customer. AI-written applications are rejected.

State your rate and confirm you can work flexible/extended hours including weekends.



We read every application that follows these steps. If you're an experienced CS pro with great spoken English who thrives under volume, we want to hear from you.

title: AI-Native Executive VA for a Multi-Business Founder (Night Shift)
description:
Please read this whole post before applying. The last section tells you exactly how to apply, and I do check for it.



I don't run one business. I run several at once — a brand launch and operations company that has put out 50+ direct-to-consumer brands, a manufacturing and logistics business serving consumer brands, a media company I operate alongside its founder, and a handful of smaller ventures and acquisitions in progress. They all need attention on the same day.



That is the actual job. I need one person who can hold context across all of it — not a specialist in one lane, but someone who can go from a product launch for a consumer brand in the morning, to a deck for the media business in the afternoon, to chasing a supplier for the logistics company, and keep every thread straight.



In one week you might build a Canva carousel for a brand launch, answer twenty customer
s in one company's voice, clean a messy order export and tell me what it means, chase a supplier who has gone quiet, put together a tracker for an entirely different business, and then rebuild the system we use to run all of it. If that variety sounds exhausting, this isn't the job for you. If it sounds like the best part, keep reading.



THE HOURS — let's be honest about them up front.

This role works US Pacific business hours: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM PT, which is 10:00 PM – 8:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday. It is a night shift. That is exactly why the pay is well above the market rate for this kind of role. If you can't sustain a night schedule long term, please don't apply — I'd genuinely rather you tell me now than three months in.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Design execution — social posts,
 headers, simple landing sections, product graphics, the occasional deck. Canva or Figma, working from existing brand templates. This is execution work, not brand identity design.

- Customer support — answering customer
 and DMs in the right brand's voice, handling refunds, returns and shipping issues, escalating only what genuinely needs me.

- Data and light tech — order exports, Shopify and ad platform reports, Google Sheets, Zapier or Make automations, and building small tools with AI when the tool you need doesn't exist yet.

- Operations and organization — running trackers across several businesses, chasing suppliers, partners and freelancers, keeping projects moving without me having to ask twice.

- Being the responsive one — during your shift, messages get acknowledged within 30 minutes. Not always a full answer, but always an acknowledgement.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

- You already use AI tools every single day — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar — and you can show me specifically how. This is the most important item on this list.

- You can hold several unrelated things in your head at once without dropping any of them. You'll be switching between businesses constantly, and each one has its own voice, customers and tools. If you need a single project at a time to do good work, you will be miserable here.

- Excellent written English. You will be writing to US customers and partners on behalf of these companies.

- You can make something look good in Canva without being told exactly what to make.

- Comfortable in Google Sheets — formulas, pivots, cleaning up messy data.

- You've worked with a US client or on a US schedule before, and it went well.

- Reliable internet plus a backup connection. A night shift with no power or internet contingency doesn't work.

- You solve first and ask second. When something breaks at 3 AM your time, I'm asleep. I need someone who makes a sensible call and tells me about it in the morning.



NICE TO HAVE

Shopify, Klaviyo, Meta Ads Manager, Zapier or Make, basic video editing, prior e-commerce or agency experience.



WHAT I OFFER

- $1,200 – $1,500 USD per month depending on experience, paid twice monthly via Wise.

- Full time, long term, working directly with me — no agency in between.

- Paid Philippine holidays, 10 days paid leave after 3 months, and a 13th month bonus.

- A paid AI tool budget, because I want you using the best tools available.

- A rare vantage point. You'll see the inside of several businesses at once — how they're launched, run and grown — which is not something most assistant roles offer.

- Real growth. The first person I hire here becomes the person who helps me hire the next one.



HOW THE HIRING WORKS

A short written application, then a 90-second screen recording of you building two things at once with AI, then a video call, then a paid two-week trial. To be clear about the recording: it takes two minutes, it is not meant to be perfect, and I'm watching how you move rather than what you produce. Messy and fast beats polished and slow.



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with the subject line "Night Owl — [your first name]" and answer these three things in your message:



1. Describe one specific task you do with an AI tool, and paste the actual prompt you use for it.

2. Tell me your real experience with a night schedule. Have you worked one? For how long? How did you handle it?

3. Link one thing you designed. Anything — a social post, a deck, a flyer.



Applications without that subject line get skipped, and so do applications that are clearly a generic template. Take fifteen minutes on this and you will stand out enormously.

title: ABA Recruiter / Talent Acquisition VA – Part-Time
description:
We are a growing ABA therapy practice serving children and families in the San Jose/Milpitas area. We are looking for a reliable, proactive, and experienced Recruiting VA to help us consistently identify and recruit qualified Behavior Technicians (BTs/RBTs).

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys recruiting, communicating with candidates, and building a strong candidate pipeline.

Position

Title: ABA Recruiter / Talent Acquisition VA

Schedule: Part-time, approximately 15–20 hours/week

Pay: $5–$8/hour, depending on experience

Location: Remote

Start: As soon as possible

What You Will Do

You will be responsible for helping us build a consistent pipeline of qualified BT/RBT candidates for our growing ABA practice.

Your responsibilities will include:

Manage and monitor our Indeed BT/RBT job postings

Review incoming applications and resumes

Identify candidates who meet our basic qualifications

Proactively search for qualified RBTs and Behavior Technicians

Contact potential candidates through appropriate recruiting platforms

Conduct initial candidate screening by phone or video

Ask candidates our predetermined screening questions

Evaluate candidates based on experience, availability, communication, and overall fit

Follow up consistently with candidates throughout the hiring process

Schedule qualified candidates for interviews with our Clinical Director

Maintain an organized candidate tracking spreadsheet

Keep detailed notes on each candidate and their stage in the hiring process

Build a pipeline of potential candidates even when we do not have an immediate opening

Help us identify additional recruiting sources and strategies

Follow up with candidates who have expressed interest but have not completed the hiring process

Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is:

Experienced in recruiting or talent acquisition

Comfortable sourcing candidates rather than simply waiting for applications

Excellent at written and verbal communication

Highly organized and detail-oriented

Proactive and able to work independently

Comfortable communicating with candidates professionally

Persistent with follow-ups without being overly aggressive

Comfortable using Indeed, LinkedIn, Google Sheets, and similar platforms

Able to identify strong candidates from resumes and conversations

Interested in learning about ABA and the qualifications we look for in BT/RBT candidates

Strongly Preferred

Experience recruiting for any of the following is a major plus:

ABA therapy

Healthcare

Behavioral health

Special education

Therapy services

Nursing/allied health

Childcare or education

Previous ABA recruiting experience is highly preferred but not required.

Important: This Is an Active Recruiting Role

We are not looking for someone who will simply post a job and wait for applications.

We want someone who can actively find qualified candidates and reach out to them.

For example, you may be expected to:

Search for experienced RBTs

Identify candidates who may be a good fit

Send personalized outreach messages

Follow up with interested candidates

Maintain a candidate pipeline

Continuously improve our recruiting process

Our goal is to consistently have qualified candidates available when new client cases become available.

How Success Will Be Measured

We will establish weekly recruiting goals based on the number of active openings, but success will generally be measured by:

Number of qualified candidates sourced

Candidate response rate

Number of candidates successfully screened

Number of qualified candidates scheduled for interviews

Quality of candidates presented

Follow-up consistency

Organization of the recruiting pipeline

Ultimately, successful hires and retention

Quality is more important than simply sending us a large number of applicants.

About We Strive ABA

We Strive ABA is a growing ABA therapy practice focused on providing individualized services to children and families.

We are a smaller practice, which means you will have the opportunity to work closely with the owner/Clinical Director and have a meaningful impact on our growth.

We value professionalism, communication, reliability, and finding the right people—not simply filling positions as quickly as possible.

To Apply

Please send us:

Your résumé or CV

A brief description of your recruiting experience

What types of positions you have recruited for

Your experience using Indeed, LinkedIn, or other recruiting platforms

Your desired hourly rate

Your available hours and time zone

Please explain how you would find experienced RBTs in the San Jose/Milpitas, California area who are not actively applying to jobs.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of recruiting and help us build a reliable pipeline of high-quality BT/RBT candidates.

title: Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME ANDA VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator 



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break

Salary: TBD



Job Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator to support our U.S.-based estimating team. This role is responsible for reviewing construction documents, performing detailed quantity takeoffs, identifying scope requirements, and preparing accurate rough carpentry estimates for commercial, multifamily, educational, prevailing wage, and other construction projects.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of wood framing construction and can independently interpret architectural and structural plans, specifications, details, sections, schedules, and general notes. Accuracy, attention to detail, organization, and clear communication are essential, particularly when identifying missing, conflicting, or unclear information.



Key Responsibilities:

Plan & Specification Review

* Review architectural, structural, and applicable civil plans.

* Review project specifications and identify requirements affecting the rough carpentry scope.

* Interpret plans, details, sections, schedules, and general notes.

* Identify discrepancies between architectural and structural drawings.

* Identify missing information and items requiring clarification or RFI.

* Review addenda, bulletins, RFIs, and revised drawings and determine their impact on the estimate.



Quantity Takeoffs

* Prepare detailed quantity takeoffs for rough carpentry materials and labor, including:

* Dimensional lumber, wall framing, wood stud walls, and interior/exterior framing

* Floor and roof framing, roof/floor/wall sheathing, plywood, and OSB

* Blocking and backing, miscellaneous wood framing, pressure-treated lumber, sill plates, and ledgers

* Posts and beams, glulam beams, LVL, and engineered wood products

* Hardware and connectors, including hold-downs, straps, clips, hangers, anchor bolts, and fastening requirements

* Trusses, roof/floor truss-related scope, and miscellaneous rough carpentry materials

* Clearly identify quantities by building, floor, area, and material type whenever applicable.



Labor Estimating

* Assist with developing labor quantities based on takeoff information.

* Understand the relationship between material quantities and field installation.

* Identify conditions that may increase labor requirements.

* Consider difficult access, height, phasing, sequencing, and other project conditions that may affect productivity.

* Identify prevailing wage or other labor requirements shown in the bid documents.



Scope Review

* Develop a thorough understanding of the complete rough carpentry scope and identify items that may be missed during a standard material takeoff.

* Review scope responsibilities and general contractor requirements.

* Account for temporary construction, equipment, hoisting, material handling, cleanup, protection, and layout.

* Identify blocking and backing, fire-treated, and pressure-treated lumber requirements.

* Review special inspection, engineering, and deferred submittal requirements.

* Coordinate rough carpentry scope with structural steel, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other trades.



Estimate Preparation

* Organize takeoffs in accordance with company estimating standards.

* Enter quantities accurately into company estimating software and templates.

* Maintain clear supporting documentation for all quantities.

* Clearly document assumptions, exclusions, and clarifications.

* Identify potential cost risks before the estimate is finalized.

* Compare estimates against historical information when available.

* Assist the lead estimator in preparing the final proposal.



Quality Control

* Perform a complete self-review of the takeoff and verify quantities against plans.

* Confirm all buildings and areas have been included.

* Review architectural quantities against structural requirements.

* Confirm plan revisions and addenda have been incorporated.

* Verify that major material quantities are reasonable.

* Check for duplicated or missing scope.

* Clearly identify questionable conditions rather than making unsupported assumptions.

* Maintain organized takeoff files so they can be easily reviewed by another estimator.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Previous experience estimating rough carpentry, wood framing, or wood-frame construction

* Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and structural construction documents

* Experience performing detailed construction quantity takeoffs

* Strong understanding of wood framing systems and construction sequencing

* Familiarity with lumber, plywood, OSB, engineered wood products, trusses, hardware, and connectors

* Strong mathematical, analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills

* Ability to manage multiple estimates and meet assigned deadlines

* Strong ability to identify scope gaps, discrepancies, and unusual project conditions

* Ability to clearly communicate questions, assumptions, and potential problems

* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a U.S.-based estimating team

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Bluebeam Revu experience preferred

* Experience with On-Screen Takeoff or similar takeoff software preferred

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams

* Experience with construction estimating software and PDF plan/specification management systems is a plus

* Willingness to ask questions and seek clarification rather than make unsupported assumptions

* Able to work during agreed-upon overlapping hours with the U.S.-based team



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

Mogul is building the financial infrastructure for independent musicians. We help artists audit their catalogs, track royalties across fragmented systems, and fix broken or missing registrations so they can collect the money they’re owed all from one place.



The music industry has long struggled with messy metadata, disconnected platforms, and opaque reporting. Candidates should be able to demonstrate previous experience with browser automation libraries like Playwright or Puppeteer. We are a small, high-velocity team and you will need to hit the ground running. Familiarity with browser automation libraries like Playwright or Puppeteer

Experience building and working with GraphQL or REST APIs

Detailed knowledge of the inner workings of modern web applications, and the ability to reverse engineer how they work

Comfortable working in an early-stage, fast-moving environment

About You

You’re an experienced software engineer that takes ownership of what they build

title: Creative Marketing Specialist — Content, Video, Social & CRM
description:
This is a part-time role designed to grow

We are looking for someone to take ownership of our content, video and social presence, and to support the marketing systems sitting behind it.



It starts at two days a week. For the right person the opportunity is considerably bigger than that — our intention is to grow the role alongside the person: more days, more scope, and in time the paid advertising we currently send outside. That progression is d
 by what you produce, not by how long you have been here.



What the role actually is

The larger part is content — video editing, graphic design and social media management. Turning raw footage shot on a phone on a building site, with no script and no shot list, into short-form video people stop scrolling for. Building the graphics and client-facing material around it, and running the calendar across Instagram,
 and 
. There is also the chance to work with professionally shot photography and video, and to put your own flair and style through our socials and website.



The rest is the machinery behind it — our CRM, our website, our search presence, and the numbers that tell us whether any of it is working. We want both halves in one person. It is a genuinely hard combination to find, which is why we are being specific rather than hoping.



The content side

- Turning raw site footage into finished Reels — walkthroughs, before-and-afters, progress, behind the scenes, the trades at work

- Cutting talking-head video with our director into something watchable

- Editing and colour-correcting project photography

- Carousels, branded graphics, marketing one-pagers, and the client-facing PDFs and information packs we send through pre-construction

- Repurposing long-form material — blogs, videos, site notes — into social-ready pieces

- Running and improving our content calendar across Instagram,
 and 

- Working with our site team to pull out the moments worth filming, and telling them what you need from them

- Watching what performs and telling us what you would change

- Bringing us ideas we did not ask for



The systems side

- Working in our CRM — pipelines, opportunities, forms, custom fields

- Supporting workflows and automations,
 and SMS campaigns

- Making sure enquiries are captured properly and followed through

- Blog uploads and page updates on our website, with half an eye on how they are structured for search

- Tracking what actually produces enquiries, not just impressions



We use GoHighLevel. Hands-on GHL experience is a real advantage and we want to hear about it in detail. Comparable CRM experience — HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Keap, Zoho — plus a genuine ability to learn systems works too. Over time we want to bring more of our paid advertising in-house, so if you understand how ads, search and analytics fit together, that is where this role has the most room to grow



How we think about AI

We use AI here every day and we expect you to. Being good with it is a skill we value.



What we are hiring is your judgement — the pacing of a cut, the hook in the first two seconds, the reason one shot follows another, the voice in a caption. Our homes are custom and our content should feel the same way: recognisably ours.



If you can point at a real piece of your own work and tell us exactly where the model helped and where you took over, you are the sort of person we want to talk to.



Who this suits

You will not be expected to work it all out alone. You will have plenty of support while you learn our business, our brand and the way we work, and we expect questions during onboarding — we collaborate closely as a team.



As you settle in we will expect you to take increasing ownership of your work. The people who do well with us bring solutions rather than questions, flag issues early rather than on the deadline, take feedback well and go around again to hit the standard, and genuinely care about what they put their name to. Every so often they send us something nobody asked for that turns out to be exactly what we needed.



If you want to be told exactly what to do each morning, this will frustrate you. If you have been looking for somewhere that gives you real ownership and rewards it, this is that.



What you need

- Around three years of hands-on content creation experience — where video, design and social content have been a meaningful part of your actual role. If you have less but a portfolio that speaks for itself, apply anyway

- Strong short-form vertical video editing — building an edit from raw, unsorted footage rather than working from a template

- Confidence in CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or DaVinci Resolve — whichever is genuinely yours, and tell us which

- Strong Canva skills and the discipline to hold an existing brand kit

- Real hands-on confidence inside a CRM, ideally GoHighLevel

- Fluency with AI tools, and the judgement to keep the creative decisions your own

- Excellent written and spoken English

- The ability to work two days a week without being chased, and to say early when

something will not be ready



Helpful, not essential: construction, architecture or property experience · Google Ads or Meta Ads · SEO fundamentals and Google Analytics · WordPress · Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or InDesign · LinkedIn content



How to apply

One honest note first. We know some people will paste this ad into an AI tool and send back whatever comes out. We are not against you using AI to help you write — we use it every day ourselves. But we can tell the difference between an application written with help and one where nobody was really there, and we only want to hear from people who actually want this particular job at this particular company.



Two of the things below cannot be produced by a tool. They are the two we read first.

1. Your resume

2. A link to your portfolio. We want to see short-form video you have edited yourself, not only static work

3. One or two sentences on our Instagram — 
 — go and look at it, then tell us one thing you would change and one thing you would keep. Be honest; we would genuinely rather hear a real criticism than a compliment

4. A few lines in your own words on why this role suits you. This one is for someone who wants to grow inside a tight-knit team and wants their work rewarded



Put the word PROCESS at the top so we know you read to the bottom.

title: AI Sales System Build (Revenue Command) — n8n + Retell AI + Twilio + CRM Integrations (Multi-Client SaaS)
description:
We run a sales and AI systems consultancy in Australia. We've already built and proven an AI sales stack for our own business — conversational SMS agents, AI voice agents, automated pipeline management and a live revenue dashboard. It works. It's producing real bookings and real revenue right now.



We're now productising it so we can deploy the same system to other sales-driven businesses: recruitment agencies, real estate agents, business brokers and similar.



We need one developer to build the productised, multi-client version. You are not inventing this from scratch — the logic, the sequences, the prompts and the workflows already exist and are running. Your job is to rebuild them properly as a repeatable, multi-tenant system that we can deploy to a new client in under a week instead of three.



What you'd be building



A four-layer system, deployed per client, managed from one place:



1. Daily briefing engine Automated morning brief and end-of-day close-out delivered to the client 
 + SMS + dashboard). Pulls from their CRM and calendar: what's booked today, who went quiet, who's due for follow-up, what moved yesterday, what needs a human. Not a data dump — a prioritised, written brief.



2. Conversational SMS agent Two-way AI SMS that qualifies inbound enquiries, books appointments, chases no-shows, nurtures cold leads and escalates to the human when the conversation needs it. Must handle real replies (not just broadcast), write back to the CRM, respect opt-outs, and know when to stop.



3. AI voice agent Outbound calling of new leads and enquiries using Retell AI over Twilio, with an Australian SIP trunk. Batch campaigns plus real-time speed-to-lead calling. Call outcomes, transcripts and dispositions sync back to the CRM. Books directly into the client's calendar.



4. Client dashboard A web dashboard where the client sees their pipeline, lead flow, agent activity, conversion rates by stage, and ROI (what the system cost vs what it produced). Login per client. This is the thing they open every morning — it needs to be genuinely good, not a wall of numbers.



Plus: a provisioning layer so onboarding a new client is configuration, not development.



Integrations required

CRM: HubSpot and GoHighLevel at minimum. Pipedrive and Salesforce as fast-follows. Must be built behind an abstraction layer — we will add CRMs and we do not want to rewrite the agents each time.

Calendar: Google Calendar, cal.com, Calendly




: Gmail / Google Workspace, Microsoft 365

Telephony: Twilio (Australian AU1 region), Retell AI

LLM: your recommendation — we care about cost per conversation, not brand names

Tech stack



Our current production stack is Make.com + Retell AI + Twilio + HubSpot. For this build we expect to move the automation layer to self-hosted n8n for cost and multi-tenancy reasons — but if you can make a strong case for a different approach, we want to hear it in your proposal. Tell us what you'd actually do and why.



For the dashboard, we're open on the stack. Something you can maintain, that we can hire for later.



Milestones

# Milestone Deliverable Est. hours

1 Foundation Multi-tenant automation infrastructure, client config layer, credential/secrets handling, logging and error alerting. One test client provisioned end to end. ~140

2 Integrations CRM, calendar and
 connectors behind a common abstraction. Two-way sync verified against a live sandbox. ~110

3 SMS agent Conversational agent live: inbound reply handling, qualification, booking, escalation, opt-out compliance, full CRM write-back. ~100

4 Voice agent Retell + Twilio AU trunk live. Batch dialler + speed-to-lead trigger. Outcomes, transcripts and recordings synced. Calendar booking from call. ~100

5 Briefing engine Morning brief + daily close-out generating and delivering reliably for the test client. ~55

6 Dashboard Client-facing dashboard, authenticated, live data, ROI reporting. ~150

7 Provisioning + handover New-client setup tooling, templates, documentation, video walkthrough, 30 days of bug support. ~60



~715 hours core + ~15% QA/revision allowance.



Milestones are paid on acceptance. We'd like to start with Milestone 1 as a standalone engagement — if it goes well, the rest follows without re-negotiation.



What we need from you

Demonstrated production work with AI voice agents — Retell, Vapi, Bland or similar. Not a tutorial project. Something real, with real call volume.

Demonstrated n8n or Make.com work at a level beyond simple linear automations — error handling, retries, queues, sub-workflows, multi-tenancy.

Twilio experience including SIP trunking and non-US number provisioning.

Real CRM API work — HubSpot or GoHighLevel specifically is a big plus.

Front-end capability for the dashboard, or a named partner you work with (tell us who, up front).

Written English good enough to work asynchronously across a 5–12 hour timezone gap.

You test your own work. We are not your QA team.

What we don't want

Anyone who has only ever built demos

Agencies who bid, win, then hand it to a junior — we want to talk to and work with the person doing the build

Anyone who needs a spec for every decision. We'll give you the logic and the outcomes; you own the technical calls.

Terms

All code, workflows and IP assigned to us on payment. NDA before we share our existing prompts, sequences and workflow logic.

Weekly 30-minute call at a time that works for both of us, plus async updates.

We supply all accounts, API keys and test data.

Ongoing retainer available after handover for maintenance and new client onboarding — this is the outcome we're hoping for.

Screening questions (put these in the Upwork job form)

Link us to an AI voice agent you have built that has handled real calls at volume. What was the call volume, and what was the connect-to-booking rate?

We're planning to move from Make.com to self-hosted n8n for multi-tenancy and cost. Do you agree with that call? If not, what would you do instead and why?

How would you architect this so that onboarding client #40 takes a few hours of configuration rather than a few days of development? Be specific.

What's your realistic all-in cost per connected AI call minute for a call to an Australian mobile, and how would you bring it down?

What hours do you work, in UTC?

Paid test task (do this before you award the full project)

title: Real Estate Research & Lead Generation
description:
# Real Estate Research & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant



## Position Overview



We are looking for a sharp, resourceful, and highly motivated **Real Estate Research & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant** to help identify, research, qualify, and organize potential real estate and short-term rental leads.



This is **NOT a simple data-entry VA position**.



We are looking for someone who can investigate information, connect the dots between multiple sources, think critically, and take ownership of getting to the end result.



The ideal candidate is technically comfortable, analytical, fast-moving, organized, and willing to learn new tools and processes.





## Core Responsibilities



You will assist with research and lead-generation activities involving real estate properties, Airbnb/VRBO listings, property owners, and potential clients.



Responsibilities may include:



* Research Airbnb and VRBO listings based on specific criteria.

* Analyze listings, reviews, ratings, amenities, booking activity, and other property information.

* Identify potentially underperforming short-term rental properties.

* Perform **skip tracing** to identify property owners and available contact information.

* Research ownership information using public records and real estate databases.

* Use Zillow, Redfin, 
, county property records, and other listing or property-information services.

* Compare property photos, listing information, maps, parcel information, and other available data to help identify properties.

* Use **Google Reverse Image Search** and similar tools when appropriate.

* Organize research findings in Google Sheets.

* Verify information across multiple sources before entering results.

* Identify relationships between Airbnb/VRBO listings, property addresses, owners, LLCs, social media profiles, and other available information.

* Maintain accurate notes explaining how conclusions were reached.

* Assist with building and maintaining prospecting databases.

* Perform additional real estate research and lead-generation tasks as the business grows.



## Required Skills



### Research & Analytical Skills



You must have:



* Strong analytical and investigative skills.

* Ability to research information across multiple websites and databases.

* Ability to recognize patterns and connect information from different sources.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to verify information instead of simply accepting the first search result.

* Ability to work through incomplete information and determine the next logical research step.



We are specifically looking for someone who can **connect the dots and accomplish the goal**, rather than getting stuck whenever the answer is not immediately obvious.



### Technical Skills



You should be comfortable working with:



* Google Sheets

* Google Search

* Google Maps

* Google Reverse Image Search

* Airbnb

* VRBO

* Zillow

* Redfin

* 
 or similar real estate platforms

* Public property records

* Skip-tracing tools

* ChatGPT and other AI tools



Advanced Google Sheets knowledge is a plus, including:



* Filters

* Sorting

* Conditional formatting

* Data validation

* Basic formulas

* Removing duplicates

* Organizing large datasets



Experience with automation tools, scraping tools, CRM systems, AirDNA, PropStream, BatchLeads, Privy, REISift, or similar platforms is a major plus - but NOT required.





## Real Estate Knowledge



Previous experience in real estate is strongly preferred.



Helpful backgrounds include:



* Real estate virtual assistant

* Real estate lead generation

* Property research

* Skip tracing

* Short-term rentals

* Airbnb/VRBO research

* Property management

* Real estate investing

* Wholesaling

* Acquisition research

* MLS or property-listing research



You do NOT need to know everything on day one. We WILL TRAIN the right candidate.



We are willing to train the right person who demonstrates strong intelligence, curiosity, work ethic, and the ability to learn quickly.





## Use of ChatGPT & AI



You should already be comfortable using ChatGPT.



We expect you to use AI as a productivity and research assistant when appropriate.



However, **copying an AI answer without verifying it is NOT acceptable**.



The goal is to combine AI, research tools, common sense, and human judgment to produce accurate results efficiently.





## What We Value Most



### Resourcefulness



When one method does not work, try another.



Do not immediately stop and say:



“I couldn't find it.”



Instead, think:



“What other information do I have, and where else can I look?”



### Speed With Accuracy



We do not expect reckless work.



We do expect someone who thinks quickly, understands the objective, and keeps moving toward the answer.



The ideal person does not need every small step explained before taking action.





### High Sense of Ownership



Ownership is extremely important in this role.



If you make a mistake:



**Own it. Fix it. Learn from it. Don't repeat it. Move on.**



We do not expect perfection.



We do expect honesty, accountability, and continuous improvement.



Do not hide mistakes or blame tools, websites, coworkers, or incomplete instructions.



Bring the issue forward and help solve it.



### Leadership



Although this position may begin as an individual contributor, we strongly value leadership ability.



A strong candidate should eventually be capable of:



* Improving processes

* Suggesting better research methods

* Creating SOPs

* Training other VAs

* Reviewing another researcher's work

* Identifying inefficiencies

* Helping build and manage a small research or lead-generation team



We are looking for someone who wants to become increasingly valuable to the organization rather than simply complete assigned tasks.



## Ideal Personality



You will probably succeed in this position if you are:



* Curious

* Analytical

* Technically comfortable

* Highly organized

* Persistent

* Fast learner

* Resourceful

* Self-directed

* Accountable

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable solving problems

* Comfortable being challenged

* Willing to learn from mistakes

* Interested in real estate and technology



You should enjoy situations where someone gives you a goal and you figure out **how to get there**.





## This Position Is NOT a Good Fit If You:



* Need extremely detailed instructions for every task.

* Give up quickly when information is difficult to find.

* Primarily want repetitive data-entry work.

* Frequently submit incomplete work without explaining what is missing.

* Copy information without verifying it.

* Are uncomfortable learning new technology.

* Avoid responsibility when mistakes occur.

* Need constant supervision to remain productive.



## Example Assignment



You may be given an assignment such as:



“Find Airbnb properties meeting these criteria, identify their likely physical addresses, research the property owners, locate publicly available contact information, and organize everything in a Google Sheet.”



You may need to use several different sources to complete the assignment.



We care about both the **final answer and the quality of the reasoning used to reach it.**



## Growth Opportunity



For the right person, this can grow well beyond a traditional VA position.



As our processes and lead-generation operation expand, there may be opportunities to become a:



* Senior Research VA

* Lead Generation Specialist

* Research Team Lead

* Operations Coordinator

* Real Estate Acquisition Research Manager



We want someone who is interested in learning the business and growing with the organization.

5. Knowledge of multi-jurisdiction payroll requirements

2. Manage trust account and operating account reconciliations on a regular basis

3. Perform three-way reconciliations across Clio Manage (or applicable practice management system), QuickBooks, and bank statements

**Guardian Home Buyers (GHB)** is looking for an **experienced Lead Manager** to join our growing real estate investment company.



This is **not an entry-level position**. We are looking for someone who already understands how to communicate with motivated sellers, follow up consistently, qualify leads, and move strong opportunities toward an acquisition appointment.



### Pay



**$3.00 USD per hour**



Opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance.



### What You Will Do



* Call and follow up with motivated seller leads

* Speak with homeowners about their property and situation

* Build rapport and have natural conversations with sellers

* Qualify leads based on motivation, timeline, property condition, price, and situation

* Determine which sellers are serious and which leads need additional follow-up

* Schedule qualified appointments for our acquisitions team

* Maintain consistent follow-up with leads who are not ready to sell immediately

* Update all notes, statuses, and follow-up tasks inside our CRM

* Respond quickly to new inbound leads

### REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must have previous experience as a:



* Real Estate Lead Manager

* Real Estate Acquisition Assistant

* Real Estate Appointment Setter

* Motivated Seller Lead Manager

**Candidates with direct U.S. real estate wholesaling experience will be strongly preferred.**



### ENGLISH REQUIREMENT — VERY IMPORTANT



You must speak **excellent, fluent, conversational English**.



Your English should be strong enough that an American homeowner feels completely comfortable speaking with you on the phone.



We are looking for someone who:



* Speaks clearly

* Understands American English easily

* Can hold a natural conversation without sounding scripted

* Has strong listening skills

* Can build rapport with homeowners

* Can confidently handle objections and difficult conversations



**A voice recording and live English interview will be required before hiring.**



### You Should Understand How to Ask Questions Like:



* Why are you considering selling the property?

* How soon are you looking to sell?

* What is the condition of the property?

* What are you hoping to get for the property?

* Previous U.S. real estate lead management experience

* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent communication skills

* Quiet professional work environment

* Comfortable making and receiving phone calls
