title: Content Strategist & Copywriter
description:
Part-Time Initially, Path to Full-Time Within Two Weeks 



Summary:

We're hiring a genuinely creative content strategist and copywriter to own the ideas and the execution behind our clients' social media. This is a part-time role starting immediately, moving to full-time as our client base grows.



The Situation:

We're a fast-growing agency working with service-based businesses across a range of industries. Our content manager has been handling content creation herself, but as we scale she needs to focus on managing.

Meanwhile, clients have told us the content feels too AI-generated and too generic. We'll keep using AI for speed, but the ideas, the angles, and the voice need to come from a real person. That's the role.



What You'll Be Doing:

- Building content calendars for multiple clients

- Writing an individual content brief for every post so our designers know exactly what to make

- Writing captions that sound like a human wrote them

- Pitching original content concepts: educational, entertainment, and CTA posts that have a real shot at performing, not just filling a slot

- Clipping long-form content in Opus for short-form use

- Maintaining and improving our anti-AI system so nothing we publish reads like a machine wrote it

- Staying current in ClickUp and Slack daily, and reviewing your tasks and client calendars at end of day

- Reporting to our content manager



What We're Looking For:

- Native or near-native English, plus a real feel for American culture, humor, and trends

- Proven social copywriting experience and a portfolio that doesn't read as AI-generated

- Someone who can take a "boring" service business and make it interesting

- An ideas person. We don't want the same five post formats recycled forever. We want someone who pushes on what's - possible and brings concepts we wouldn't have thought of

- An understanding of the difference between vanity metrics and actual results (leads, booked meetings)

- Comfort using AI in your workflow while keeping the output human

- Ability to work independently, take feedback, and communicate well with the team



The Opportunity:

We're growing fast. This starts part-time with hours based on current workload, and becomes full-time as we bring on more clients. There's real room to grow here for the right person.



To Apply, please send us three things:

1. Your portfolio, or 3 to 5 examples of social content you personally wrote (note which parts were yours)

2. One content idea you'd pitch for a service business in a "boring" industry. Two or three sentences is plenty, no design needed. We mostly want to see how you think

3. Your hourly rate, weekly availability, and whether you're interested in full-time down the road



We're hiring immediately and want to start ASAP.

title: B2B Cold Call Appointment Setter
description:
Nexus Pay is a veteran-owned merchant services company based in Aurora, Colorado, USA. We help American businesses lower their credit card processing costs through a free statement analysis that finds hidden fees and overcharges.



We are hiring experienced B2B cold callers to phone US small businesses, reach the owner or decision-maker, and do ONE of two things:



1. Book a 15-minute phone appointment for a free processing cost review, OR

2. Get the owner to agree to submit their most recent processing statement through our free analysis page.



You are NOT closing sales. You are opening doors. We provide the script, objection handlers, call list, dialer access (softphone app — nothing to buy), and training.



COMPENSATION

- Base: $5–$8/hour depending on experience and trial performance

- Bonus: $15 per qualified appointment that shows (the decision-maker actually attends)

- Shortlisted applicants get a PAID 20-call test batch, then a 1-week paid trial. Top performers stay long-term with raises and higher bonus tiers.



SCHEDULE

- Part-time to start: 4 hours per day, Monday–Friday (20 hours/week)

- Shifts fall between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM US Mountain Time — currently 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine time. This is a NIGHT SHIFT role. Please apply only if you can commit to these hours reliably, every week.



REQUIREMENTS

- Fluent, clear spoken English with a neutral accent (you will be calling US business owners)

- Minimum 1 year of B2B cold calling or appointment setting for US companies — financial services, merchant services, SaaS, or insurance strongly preferred

- Reliable computer, quiet workspace, quality USB headset, stable internet (10+ Mbps)

- Comfortable making 60+ outbound dials per 4-hour shift

- Experience with any dialer or CRM (we provide ours and will train you)

- Willing to sign our communications compliance acknowledgment (US calling rules and Do-Not-Call handling) before your first call. All dialing is manual — we do not use auto-dialers.



KPIs AFTER A 1-WEEK RAMP

- 60+ dials per shift

- 8+ decision-maker conversations per shift

- 1+ booked appointment OR statement submission per shift



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY

Start your application with the word CARDINAL so I know you read the whole post. Then include all five of the following:



1. A link to a 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo or Google Drive) of you reading the first two paragraphs of this job post aloud

2. How many years of B2B cold calling experience you have, and in what industries

3. What dialers/CRMs you have used

4. The exact hours you can reliably commit, Monday–Friday

5. Two or three sentences: how do you get past a gatekeeper to reach a business owner?



Applications without the voice recording will not be reviewed.

What projects are active

* Have a proven track record of results



PROOF OF RESULTS REQUIRED



I am not interested in shared screenshots, screenshots taken from other credit repair groups, or results that cannot be connected to your own work.



Applicants should be prepared to explain specific cases they personally handled, including:



* What was being disputed

* What strategy/method was used

* How long the process took

* What the final outcome was



Client information may be redacted for privacy.



WHEN APPLYING



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. How many years have you personally handled credit sweeps?

2. Approximately how many sweep clients have you personally worked?

3. Walk me through your dispute method from the time you receive a client’s reports until completion.

4. What determines which dispute method you use for a particular account?

5. How do you handle accounts that survive the initial dispute?

6. What is your escalation process?

7. How do you organize and track clients, deadlines, responses, and subsequent rounds?

8. What credit repair/dispute software have you worked with?

9. Provide examples of results from cases you personally handled.

10. What is your expected rate per client?

11. How many clients can you comfortably manage at one time?



IMPORTANT: Do not send a generic application. Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be considered.



COMPENSATION



Pay Per Client — Negotiable Based on Experience & Proven Results



I am willing to pay more for the right specialist. I am looking for quality, consistency, communication, and results — not simply the lowest rate.



This can become a long-term working relationship with consistent client volume for the right person.

title: Virtual Assistant / Bookkeeper – Xero Experience Required
description:
We are looking for a reliable, organised and proactive Virtual Assistant / Bookkeeper to provide ongoing support to a New Zealand accounting practice.

This is a part-time remote position suited to someone with bookkeeping, administration or junior accounting experience who is confident using Xero and Microsoft Excel.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of regular bookkeeping and administrative tasks and become a dependable part of our team.



About the Role



The role will involve a combination of general administration, bookkeeping and accounting support.

A key part of the position is managing regular and recurring responsibilities. Once trained, you will be expected to keep track of your assigned daily, weekly and monthly tasks and complete them on schedule.

You will receive appropriate training on our procedures and systems, but we are looking for someone who can become increasingly independent as they become familiar with the role.



Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

• Preparing daily reports of client updates

• Completing daily Xero bank reconciliations for assigned clients

• Importing bank statements into Xero and Excel

• Assisting with the preparation and filing of tax returns and other routine filings

• Preparing and maintaining Excel spreadsheets

• Drafting routine client letters,
s and other correspondence

• Assisting with new client onboarding

• Preparing, finalising and publishing client reports

• Processing client payroll

• Maintaining client records and documentation

• Completing data entry and basic accounting tasks

• Following up outstanding information and administrative matters

• Maintaining internal checklists and recurring task schedules

• Assisting with other bookkeeping, accounting support and administrative tasks as required



Essential Requirements

Applicants must:

• Have experience using Xero

• Have good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel

• Have bookkeeping, accounting support or relevant administrative experience

• Have strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy

• Have good written English and be comfortable preparing professional correspondence

• Be organised and capable of managing recurring deadlines independently

• Be comfortable learning new systems and procedures

• Have reliable high-speed internet

• Have a suitable and professional home workstation

• Be able to maintain strict confidentiality when dealing with client financial and personal information

• Have no criminal history

Experience with New Zealand accounting, payroll or Inland Revenue processes would be an advantage, but training can be provided to the right candidate.



Who We Are Looking For

The ideal person is someone who is:

• Reliable – if something is due, we can trust that it will be completed

• Organised – you can manage multiple recurring tasks and deadlines

• Proactive – you don’t need to wait to be told what to do every day

• Detail-oriented – you notice mistakes, discrepancies and missing information

• Comfortable with routine – you are happy completing regular daily, weekly and monthly processes

• Willing to learn – you can follow established procedures and improve as you gain experience

• Communicative – if you encounter a problem or cannot complete something, you raise it rather than allowing a deadline to pass



We value reliability, accuracy and initiative more than formal accounting qualifications.

Hours & Working Arrangement

This is a part-time, ongoing remote role.

The position is intended for someone who can provide consistent support each week and be available to complete regular tasks according to agreed deadlines.

The exact hours and working arrangements can be discussed with the successful applicant.



How to Apply

Please provide:

• A brief introduction about yourself

• Details of your previous bookkeeping or accounting support experience

• Your experience with Xero and Microsoft Excel

• Any experience you have with New Zealand accounting, payroll or Inland Revenue

• Your current availability and preferred number of hours per week

• Details of your home workstation and internet connection

• Your expected hourly rate

Please also briefly explain how you currently manage recurring tasks and deadlines without needing to be reminded.

We are looking for someone interested in building a reliable, ongoing working relationship, rather than a short-term project.
